## Review

**8 out of 10, Strong.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The 72 pages I inspected show a disciplined investor-day template with a consistent green and navy palette, speaker dividers, action titles and large, readable numbers. The argument connects well: returns on slide 5, a targets scorecard on slide 9, then market size, then the business case, with 'perception vs reality' framing on slides 20 and 44 and the originate-then-distribute logic on slides 54 to 66. A few pages weaken the polish: the planet graphics on slide 13 put white numerals over busy textures, the title-less image slides 57 and 72 are hard to read without the speaker, and small footnotes and pie labels on slides 64 and 27 are tiny. I only saw 72 of 214 pages, and the density and image-led pages depend on a spoken presentation.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the slide 5 and slide 9 chart-plus-callout treatment, the consistent section dividers with speaker names, and the before-and-after comparison layouts on slides 20, 44 and 52.

**Most useful repair:** Replace the planet illustrations on slide 13 with a plain sized-bubble or bar layout so the numbers sit on a clean background and can be compared, and enlarge the labels on slides 27 and 64.

**What would change the score:** Add a one-line title to the image-only slides 57 and 72, and thin out the footnote and legend text so more of each chart can be read at a distance.

_Confidence medium. 72 of 214 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

Apollo's 2024 Investor Day deck opens with a title slide, then a long forward-looking statements and disclosures page, followed by a welcome from the Global Head of Investor Relations and an agenda listing each presenter. The strategy section comes next, covering a decade of shareholder returns, progress against 2021 targets, the industry backdrop and new five-year growth targets. Business unit sections follow for asset management (investing and origination), credit, equity, real assets, capital formation, institutional capital, capital solutions, global wealth, retirement services, culture and financial strategy. The deck closes with a summary of takeaways and a Q&A session. It uses a consistent green-and-white template with a section divider before each speaker, large headline-style titles, and a mix of bar charts, timelines and simple diagrams. Several slides, such as the 2021 to 2024 targets scorecard and the Athene ecosystem growth bars, show how a single chart can carry a whole argument. Dense text appears mainly in the legal disclosures and some appendix-style slides. Slide 4 (agenda) and slide 9 (targets scorecard) are worth studying for how they handle information density.

## Questions about this deck

**How many slides does the Apollo Global Management Investor Day 2024 deck have?**

The deck has 214 pages. Slide 4 is the Investor Day agenda, which lists each topic, presenter and title.

**What does the Apollo Global Management Investor Day 2024 deck say about its stock price since the IPO?**

Slide 5 shows the Apollo stock price rising from $18 per share at the March 2011 IPO to $126 per share at the October 2024 Investor Day, which is about 7x. The slide also reports a 24% annualized total return since NYSE listing versus 14% for the S&P 500.

**What targets does Apollo Global Management set out in the Investor Day 2024 deck for AUM and origination?**

Slide 9 lists AUM of ~$1T with a status of on track for the 2026 target, and an updated target of ~$1.5T for the next five years. For origination, it lists $150B+ as ahead for the 2026 target, with an updated target of $275B+, and notes that targets may not be achieved.

**What does the Apollo Global Management Investor Day 2024 deck say about the size of the retirement market?**

Slide 15 gives the global retirement market as ~$45 TRILLION. It also states that 1+ BILLION people worldwide will be retirement age by 2030, which the footnote describes as an estimate.

**Layout**

Single white slide with a left-hand bar chart occupying roughly the left two-thirds and a right-hand statistic panel separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about x 71%. The title sits full-width at the top left (x 3.1%, y 6.9%) with a small running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 above it and the APOLLO wordmark top right; left alignment throughout with a margin of about 3% on the left and about 3% on the right. A footnote runs along the bottom left and the page number sits bottom right.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled Apollo Stock Price with unit line $ per share; five bars with value labels above each bar: March 2011 IPO $18, December 2014 Investor Day $23, November 2019 Investor Day $43, October 2021 Investor Day $73, October 2024 Investor Day (footnote 1) $126. Bars are solid #007B63 green, equal width (about 6% of slide width each), bottom-aligned on a thin light grey #BFBFBF baseline spanning about x 6.8% to 66.8% at y 76.9%. Bar heights are proportional to values, starting from zero; the category labels are printed beneath each bar in uppercase. A grey #BFBFBF arrow (about 2px line with filled triangular head) runs diagonally from just above the $18 bar (about x 14%, y 66%) up to just below the $126 label (about x 56%, y 20%), passing behind a circle. The circle is an outlined ring, about 10% wide, with a white interior and a #BFBFBF outline about 2px thick, centred at about x 34.5%, y 43%, containing the text ~7x in green. The right panel contains a large 24% figure in green with the label Annualized Total Return Since NYSE Listing and a second line vs. S&P 500: 14% in black. No photographs, logos other than the APOLLO wordmark, or icons.

**Design**

Background pure white #FFFFFF with no gradient or texture. Slide title in Garamond-style serif, regular weight, black #000000, cap height roughly 4.8% of slide height. Running header and category labels in a small uppercase humanist sans (Segoe UI), regular with wide letter-spacing, black #000000, about 1.5% of slide height. Chart title Apollo Stock Price and value labels in Segoe UI Semilight, green #007B63, about 4.1% of slide height for labels. Unit line $ per share in Segoe UI Italic black, about 2.4%. Large statistic 24% in Segoe UI Light green #007B63, about 15% of slide height; panel labels in Segoe UI Semilight black, about 4.1%; 7x in green Segoe UI Semilight about 8.2%. Accent colour is green #007B63 with light grey #BFBFBF for arrow, circle and baseline. Bars are flat rectangles with square corners and no shadows; the vertical divider is a thin grey line about 1px.

**Layout**

Four equal columns of centred content sit below a left-aligned title, with thin vertical dividers between columns. The title sits top-left at about 3% margin with the running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 above it and the APOLLO wordmark top-right. Each column stacks a pale circular icon badge, a coloured heading, and black body text; the footnote sits bottom-left and the page number bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Four line icons in pale circular badges, left to right. (1) A blue (#5B8FCB) outline envelope with its flap open, an arrow-style chevron pointing right, and a blue outline door/panel, meaning One Share, One Vote. (2) A dark slate-blue (#3B5A7E) outline boardroom scene: an oval/rounded conference table seen from above-front with about six high-backed chairs with five-star castor bases around it. (3) A green (#007B63) outline row of four standing figures, two in dresses and two in trousers, holding hands. (4) An orange (#E8934F) outline coin with a dollar sign inside concentric rings, a vertical line through the S, and an open arc on the lower-right. No photographs. Vertical divider lines are light grey (#C8C8C8) hairlines, about 0.1% wide, spanning from about 19% to 90% of slide height at x about 26.2, 49.9 and 73.6 percent.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with no texture, gradient or shadow. Left margin about 3% of width; content is left-aligned within each row.

**Visuals**

Three numbered milestone rows, each made of an outlined circle, a pale blue right-pointing chevron, and text. Row 1: navy outlined circle labelled 2014 with a pale blue chevron reading ~2x AUM by 2019, followed by a green outlined check-mark circle and the text Achieved in <4 years. Row 2: navy outlined circle labelled 2019 with a pale blue chevron reading ~2x AUM & FRE by 2024, followed by a green outlined check-mark circle and the text Achieved in ~4 years. Row 3: navy outlined circle labelled 2021 with a larger pale blue chevron reading ~2.5x FRE, ~1.75x SRE, ~2x ANI with the sub-line + Origination, Capital Solutions, Global Wealth targets by 2026, followed by green text Ahead or On Track for All Metrics with no check mark. Check marks are thin green strokes inside green outlined circles. No photographs, no charts, no icons other than the checks.

**Design**

Header label and page number in Segoe UI-style sans, black #000000, about 1.5% of slide height. Milestone years in Segoe UI Semilight, navy #385878, about 6.7% of slide height. Chevron headline text in Segoe UI Semibold, navy #385878, about 3.9%. Sub-lines in Segoe UI Italic and Regular, dark warm grey #4A433C, about 3.0% to 3.3%. Result text in Segoe UI Regular, black #000000 for Achieved, about 4.4%. Ahead-group text in Segoe UI Regular, green #007B63, about 4.4%. Circle outlines navy #385878 with a thin stroke of about 0.3% of slide height and no fill. Chevrons filled #EDF3F9 with no outline, no shadow, no rounded corners. Check circles outlined in #007B63 with a thin stroke.

A centred Apollo Today lockup (rocket icon, moon, wordmark, 'Today') sits near the bottom centre, above a two-line footnote block at the bottom left and the slide number bottom right.

**Visuals**

Four planet illustrations in a flat, painted-texture style on white, left to right: (1) a teal planet with a dark-teal and cream-striped ring system tilted diagonally, containing the value $75T+; (2) a brown and tan banded planet with a dark red oval spot near its lower third and no rings, containing ~$45T; (3) a bright red planet with a dark red outline and a tan and gold ring system tilted across its middle, containing ~$150T; (4) a blue planet with lighter blue horizontal bands and no rings, containing ~$50T. **Layout**

Three-column composition on a white field: a left column of three green items under the heading Massive Capital Demand, a centred Apollo brand block flanked by two half-diamond chevrons, and a right column of three slate items under the heading Full Solutions in Limited Supply. The slide title sits top-left below a small running header at the left margin, with the APOLLO wordmark top-right; the footnote sits bottom-left and the page number bottom-right, all on a margin of about 3 percent of slide width.

**Visuals**

Three line icons in the left column, each inside a pale mint circle and drawn in green #007B63 with thin strokes: (1) a wind turbine with three blades and wind-swirl lines beside a row of solar panels, (2) a single-circuit electricity pylon in lattice form, (3) a microchip with a square die in the centre and pins along all four sides. Three line icons in the right column, each inside a pale grey circle and drawn in slate #385878 with thin strokes: (1) an hourglass, (2) two horizontal arrows, one pointing left above one pointing right, (3) a brick wall with one brick tilted on top. In the centre, a light grey (about #E4E6E8) line drawing of a suspension bridge with two arched towers and vertical suspenders, sitting above the APOLLO wordmark; the wordmark is a green #007B63 serif wordmark in spaced capitals. Two half-diamond chevrons flank the centre: the left one pale mint #E9F3F1 pointing left, the right one pale grey #EDF0F3 pointing right, both with flat inner edges against the centre column. No photographs or charts.

15

**Layout**

Two-zone slide with a large pale-blue circle statistic on the left, a grey chevron pointing right at centre, and a rising seven-box staircase diagram with side labels on the right. The title sits top-left below a small running header at the top-left and an APOLLO wordmark at top-right, both left and right aligned to a margin of about 3% of slide width. The footnote line spans the bottom at about 95% height with the page number 15 at bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Illustration-style composition with no photographs. (1) Large filled circle, centred at about x 20.6%, y 48.1%, diameter about 28.8% of slide width, fill #E8F0F8, containing the statistic '~$45 TRILLION1', 'Global Retirement Market', '1+ BILLION' and 'People Worldwide will be Retirement Age by 2030²' in the circle and below it. (2) Solid chevron/triangle arrow, fill #D4CFC9, pointing right, apex at about x 45.0%, spanning y 38.9% to 74.8% at its left edge, x 40.1% to 45.2%. (3) Staircase diagram of seven outlined rectangles, each white fill with a thin blue or green outline about 2 px wide, stepping up from bottom-left to top-right: bottom 'New International Opportunities' (blue #3777B4 outline and text, x 53.8%, y 83.0%, w 15.0%, h 8.0%); 'RILA³' (blue, x 57.7%, y 73.7%); 'Stable Value' (blue, x 61.6%, y 64.3%); 'Structured Settlements' (blue, x 65.6%, y 55.0%); 'Tax-Advantaged Products' (green #007B63 outline and text, x 69.5%, y 45.7%); 'Guaranteed Lifetime Income' (green, x 73.4%, y 36.3%); 'Defined Contribution / 401(k)' (green, x 77.4%, y 27.0%). No arrows connect the boxes; they step diagonally. (4) Faint light-grey diagonal arrow behind the staircase, colour about #E6E6E6, thick stroke, running from about x 43.5%, y 90% up to an arrowhead at about x 96%, y 14%. (5) Two square-bracket shapes: a mint bracket about #C8E3DA at x 63.4%, y 26.7%, w 2.6%, h 26.5%, enclosing the three green boxes and labelled 'New Markets'; and a grey bracket about #DCE2E6 at x 81.0%, y 54.6%, w 2.4%, h 36.5%, enclosing the lower four boxes and labelled 'Adjacent Markets'. Lighting and photography: none.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with minimal flat graphics. Title in a Garamond-style book serif, regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. Body and labels in Segoe UI style humanist sans-serif, regular weight, black #000000 at about 3% of slide height for body and 2.6% for box labels. Accent blue #3777B4 for the statistic, box labels and outlines; green #007B63 for the New Markets group and its labels; pale blue #E8F0F8 circle; taupe #D4CFC9 chevron; light grey tints for decorative arrow and brackets. Big statistic in Segoe UI Light about 21% of slide height; 'TRILLION' in Segoe UI Semibold, all caps, widely letter-spaced. Shapes have square corners, no shadows, no gradients.

**Layout**

Single-slide layout with a title block at top left, a kicker line above it, and a wordmark at top right. The left third holds a pale blue TAM circle with a bracket, the centre holds three stacked percentage labels with thin leader lines, and the right half holds a three-tier pyramid with a grey circular callout and diagonal arrow. Left margin is about 3.1% of width, the title sits at 6.9% from the top, the source line sits at the bottom left at about 95% of height, and the page number sits at the bottom right at about 96% of width.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a pyramid of three stacked trapezoidal tiers, apex at top. Top tier (Family Office) is pale blue #E3ECF6 with the label Family Office in dark slate #385878. Middle tier (High Net Worth) is mid blue #699ED1 with white bold label High Net Worth. Bottom tier (Mass Affluent) is dark slate #385878 with white bold label Mass Affluent. The tiers share a common vertical centre axis, and the bottom tier is the widest. Grey hairline leader lines (#BFBFBF, about 0.1% stroke) run horizontally from the left edge of the tier boundaries at the top and middle tiers to the percentage labels. Left element: a pale blue circle #E8F0F8 holding ~$150T in light blue #3777B4 with TAM beneath in bold letter-spaced caps; a pale blue (#E8F0F8) bracket with a vertical stem and short horizontal ends at top and bottom spans the circle's height. Right element: a thin light grey (#D9D9D9) diagonal arrow runs from upper left to lower right, ending in a filled grey arrowhead, and passes into a white circle outlined in light grey (#D9D9D9) that holds the label INDUSTRY / DIRECTION / OF TRAVEL in slate #385878. No photographs, logos or icons other than the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF background. Clean white corporate look. Titles in a high-contrast serif (Garamond regular, black #000000). Kicker, body and labels in Segoe UI, with light and semilight weights for large figures and semibold for pyramid labels. Title height is about 4.8% of slide height, large figures about 7.4% of slide height, pyramid labels about 4.1%, and small labels and footer about 1.3% to 2.5%. Accent colours: TAM blue #3777B4, slate #385878, mid blue #699ED1, pale blue #E3ECF6 and #E8F0F8, risk red #C00000 for the percentages of 2% and 1%, grey #D9D9D9 for the arrow and circle outline. Shapes are flat with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners. Percentages are set in a light weight with the tilde and percent sign smaller than the digits.

- Worth keeping: Keep the slide 5 and slide 9 chart-plus-callout treatment, the consistent section dividers with speaker names, and the before-and-after comparison layouts on slides 20, 44 and 52.

**Layout**

Two equal columns split by a thin vertical grey divider line at about x 50%, running from about y 14% to y 91%. **Visuals**

A set of outlined boxes and a downward-pointing triangle, no photographs or charts. ### Slide 27

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A side-by-side comparison of Athene against public corporates uses restrained color and labeled blocks to make the contrast immediate.
- Review: A few pages weaken the polish: the planet graphics on slide 13 put white numerals over busy textures, the title-less image slides 57 and 72 are hard to read without the speaker, and small footnotes and pie labels on slides 64 and 27 are tiny.
- Suggested repair: Replace the planet illustrations on slide 13 with a plain sized-bubble or bar layout so the numbers sit on a clean background and can be compared, and enlarge the labels on slides 27 and 64.

**Layout**

Single full-width chart slide on a white field with the title at top left under a small running header and the APOLLO wordmark at top right, both aligned to a margin of about 3 percent. The chart spans the body with the x-axis baseline near 81 percent of slide height, the legend in one row below the year labels, and the two-line footnote bottom left with the page number 28 bottom right.

**Visuals**

Stacked vertical column chart titled Gross Organic Inflows, with a subtitle-style label at top left. Eleven columns, one per year from 2014 to 2024E, left to right. Column totals printed above each bar: 2014 $3B, 2015 $4B, 2016 $9B, 2017 $11B, 2018 $13B, 2019 $18B, 2020 $28B, 2021 $37B, 2022 $48B, 2023 $63B, 2024E $70B. No axis scale or gridlines are printed. Segment values are not printed; segments are about proportional to the column heights. Stack order from bottom: Retail Annuities (dark blue #385878), Flow Reinsurance (mid blue #699ED1), Pension Group Annuities (light blue #ABC7E5), Funding Agreements (teal #92CBD6). The 2024E column is split: the top about 27 percent is a grey diagonal hatch on white with a thin grey outline, labelled $70B above it, and is footnote 1 (previously announced target). The 2024E column carries superscript 1 after the year and the legend's Funding Agreements carries superscript 2. A black straight arrow with a filled arrowhead runs from just above the 2014 column up to the upper right near the 2024E label, rising across the chart. A dark blue #385878 ellipse with a thin black outline sits on the arrow near the 2019 to 2020 columns and contains the white text ~23x. Legend below the year axis: four square swatches with labels in order Retail Annuities, Flow Reinsurance, Pension Group Annuities, Funding Agreements. No highlighted points other than the ellipse and the hatched 2024E column.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background. Title in a light serif (Garamond-style), black #000000, regular weight, large. Running header and legend labels in a humanist sans (Segoe UI style), regular weight, all capitals with wide letter-spacing in the legend. Column totals in semibold sans #595959. Year labels in regular sans #111111. Accent colours are the blue and teal family: #385878, #699ED1, #ABC7E5, #92CBD6. Title is about 4.8 percent of slide height; body and labels about 2.6 percent; footnote about 1.3 percent. Bars are flat with no shadows or gradients; the baseline is a thin light grey rule. Ellipse has a black outline of about 0.1 percent of slide height.

### Slide 29

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Capital / Primary Equity Capital / Raised Since 2010 / Regulatory Capital Backing Reserves / 1 / $35B / $33B / $28B / $23B / $20B / $19B / $18B / $15B / $13B / $10B / $9B / Rest of Industry / We Have Led the Industry in Raising Capital / Note: Athene and Apollo data as of June 30, 2024. Peer data as of December 31, 2023. 1. Represents the aggregate capital of Athene's U.S. and Bermuda insurance entities, determined with respect to each insurance entity by applying the statutory accounting principles applicable to / each such entity. Adjustments are made to, among other things, assets and expenses at the holding company level. Includes capital from the non-controlling interests in ACRA as well as ~$4B of undrawn, on-demand equity capital in ADIP. For peers, regulatory capital is U.S. statutory / total adjusted capital plus Bermuda total adjusted capital and exclusive of all non-U.S. and Bermuda regulatory capital. / 29

**Layout**

Two-column chart slide on a white field. A header row sits at the top with 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' flush left and the APOLLO wordmark flush right, both at about 4 to 5 percent from the top; the title 'Capital' sits flush left below it at about 7 percent. A thin vertical divider at about 25.4 percent of width separates a left panel (Primary Equity Capital, about 3 to 22 percent of width) from a right panel (Regulatory Capital Backing Reserves, about 28 to 96 percent). A grey callout band spans the lower slide at about 81 to 89 percent height, and a three-line footnote sits bottom left at about 92 to 96 percent with the page number '29' bottom right at about 95 percent. Left margin is about 3 percent; right margin about 3.5 percent.

**Visuals**

Two vertical bar charts with no printed axes, gridlines or axis units; values are printed above each bar. Left chart: 'Primary Equity Capital Raised Since 2010', two bars on a shared baseline: Athene/Apollo $20B (dark blue bar, label in blue) and Rest of Industry $28B (light grey bar, label in dark grey). Right chart: 'Regulatory Capital Backing Reserves' with superscript 1, nine vertical bars on one baseline in descending order, each with a printed value label above and a logo below: MassMutual $35B (light grey bar), Athene $33B (dark blue bar, highlighted, label in blue), Prudential $23B (grey), MetLife $19B (grey), corebridge financial $18B (grey), Manulife $15B (grey), Pacific Life $13B (grey), Lincoln Financial Group $10B (grey), Global Atlantic $9B (grey). Bars are flat rectangles with no legend; the dark blue bars are the only highlighted series. Logos are: MassMutual wordmark with three-dot mark above; Athene wordmark with swoosh mark; Prudential wordmark with round blue emblem above; MetLife wordmark with blue and green icon above; corebridge financial wordmark with purple dot cluster; Manulife wordmark with green three-bar mark above; Pacific Life wordmark with arched emblem above; Lincoln Financial Group with maroon head silhouette; Global Atlantic Financial Group with teal swirl mark. Left chart base logos: ATHENE over APOLLO wordmarks, then the text 'Rest of Industry'. Baselines are thin light grey horizontal lines under each chart, and the divider is a thin vertical grey line (about #BFBFBF, estimated).

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF across the full slide. Plain white background with no gradients or textures. Title 'Capital' in a high-contrast serif (Garamond-like, regular weight) black #000000 at about 4.8 percent of slide height. Section heads and 'Rest of Industry' use SegoeUI-Semibold / Segoe UI black #000000 at about 3 percent of height. Value labels use Segoe UI regular at about 3.3 percent of height in black #000000, with dark blue #385878 for highlighted values and #404040 for the $28B label. Accent colour dark blue #385878; bar grey #E6E6E6; callout band fill #F2F2F2 with headline text in warm dark grey #4A433C, Segoe UI regular at about 4.1 percent of height. Footnote and page number in Segoe UI at about 1.3 percent of height, black. Bars are solid flat rectangles with square corners, no shadows, no outlines. Header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' is Segoe UI capitals, letter-spaced, about 1.5 percent of height.

**Layout**

Single chart slide with a small uppercase header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' at top left and a wordmark 'APOLLO' at top right, with a large serif title 'Management' below the header at top left. Twelve vertical bars span the full width between about x 8 and x 93 on a common baseline at y 74, with year labels centred under each bar, the chart caption centred below at y 82.5, a footnote at bottom left and the page number at bottom right at y 95.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled 'Athene Ecosystem Gross Invested Assets' with superscript 1 and unit ($B), footnote 1 'Includes the non-controlling interests in ACRA.' Categories on x-axis are 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2Q'24; no y-axis or gridlines are drawn and values are printed above each bar. Series values: 2013 $60B, 2014 $59B, 2015 $67B, 2016 $72B, 2017 $82B, 2018 $111B, 2019 $125B, 2020 $175B, 2021 $210B, 2022 $238B, 2023 $279B, 2Q'24 $302B. Bars 2013 to 2017 are pale grey-blue #E1E6EB, bars 2018 to 2020 are pale blue #E3ECF6, bars 2021 to 2Q'24 are pale mint #DEEEEB. Bar heights are proportional to the printed values with the baseline at y 74. Three grey-blue to green callout boxes sit above the chart. A grey-blue bracket arrow runs from above the 2013 bar ($60) to above the 2018 bar ($111) labelled with the box '+$51B over 5 years'. A blue bracket arrow labelled ADIP I runs from above the 2018 bar to above the 2021 bar ($210) with the box '+$99B over 3 years'. A green bracket arrow labelled MANDATORY CONVERTIBLE above and ADIP II to its right runs from above the 2021 bar to above the 2Q'24 bar ($302) with the box '+$92B over 3 years'. No legend and no highlighted points beyond the bracket arrows.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF with no decoration. Title 'Management' in Garamond regular black #000000 at about 4.8 percent of slide height. **Layout**

Single full-width content slide with a left-aligned serif title at top left under a small running header, and a small wordmark at top right. A bar chart with a line overlay spans the middle and lower slide on a shared baseline, with a row of three outlined circles beneath it and a two-line footnote at the bottom left. The slide number sits at bottom right, with margins of about 3 percent on left and right.

**Visuals**

Combined bar and line chart. Bars: nine vertical columns, one per year 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024E, filled #CAC2BA with no outline, sitting on a thin light-grey baseline (#D9D9D9) with small tick marks between years. Printed bar value labels above or inside bars: 2016 $0.7B, 2017 $1.1B, 2018 $1.3B (printed inside the bar top), 2019 $1.4B (printed inside the bar top), 2020 $1.3B, 2021 $2.5B, 2022 $2.5B, 2023 $3.1B, 2024E $3.2B. No value axis, scale or units are printed beyond the $ B labels; bar heights are roughly proportional to the labelled values. Line series: '3M SOFR / Athene SRE' drawn as a thick dark blue (#385878) polyline with rounded ends, about 6 px stroke, unlabelled values; approximate shape: starts low near 2016 (about 0.7 of the way up the 2016 bar's scale), rises gradually through 2017 and 2018 to a peak in late 2018 near the top of the 2019 bar region, falls through 2019 and drops sharply in 2020 to near the baseline, stays flat through 2021, rises steeply through 2022, levels off at the top across 2023 and 2024E, then after 2024E a short solid segment drops and continues as three dotted blue points descending to the right (projection). Legend: no separate legend box; the series name is printed as a label at the left of the line's start, '3M SOFR' in blue and 'Athene SRE' in grey, with superscript 1. Highlighted points: none marked by markers. Three outlined circles below the chart in a row labelled '% Net Floating Rate Assets' with superscript 2: circle under 2016 containing 29%, circle under 2019 containing 17%, circle under 2024E containing 7% with superscript 3. Circles are unfilled, stroked #617993 about 2 px, diameter about 4.8 percent of slide width.

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

**Layout**

Single-column chart slide on a white field with a left-aligned title at the top left and a small running header above it, a column chart spanning the full width, and a grey caption band below the axis. The 2029E target bar sits at the far right after a gap, with a circular callout between the bars and the target. The footnote sits bottom left and the page number bottom right, both at the margin.

**Visuals**

Column chart, title 'Athene Ecosystem Gross Invested Assets ($B)' printed in the grey caption band below the axis, not as a chart title. Y-axis: no axis or gridlines shown; values are printed on each bar, so no range is labelled. X-axis: years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2Q'24, then a gap, then 2029E. Single series, light blue columns (#E3ECF6) with values printed inside the top of each column in blue (#3777B4): 2013 $60B, 2014 $59B, 2015 $67B, 2016 $72B, 2017 $82B, 2018 $111B, 2019 $125B, 2020 $175B, 2021 $210B, 2022 $238B, 2023 $279B, 2Q'24 $302B. Column heights are roughly proportional to the printed values, with the 2Q'24 column about 20.6% of slide height tall and 2013 about 4.1%. The 2029E column is an outline-only rectangle, white fill with a pale blue outline (about #9DC3E6), about 3.2% wide and 42.8% tall, labelled '~$600B Target' above it. Highlighted point: a grey (#BFBFBF) circle callout with a white fill and a 2pt grey outline, containing '~15%' in blue and 'Avg Ecosystem Growth over Next ~5 Years' in dark grey; a grey straight arrow runs from the circle's lower-left edge down-left toward the 2Q'24 column top, and a second grey arrow runs from the circle's upper-right edge up-right to the top of the 2029E outline bar, with an arrowhead. Hidden elements: six light blue (#E3ECF6) rectangles at x 65.0 to 88.8 with increasing heights are covered by white rectangles and are not visible. Legend: none.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with no gradient or texture. Title in black (#000000) Garamond regular, roughly 4.8% of slide height cap-to-descender, sentence-case with parenthesised '+'. Running header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' in black (#000000) Segoe UI, all caps, about 1.5% of slide height, letter-spaced slightly. 'APOLLO' top right in black serif small caps, about 1.5% of slide height. Body and data labels in Segoe UI regular, about 2.6% of slide height, value labels in blue #3777B4. Caption band text in Segoe UI Semilight, about 4.1% of slide height, dark warm grey #4A433C. Accent colour blue #3777B4, pale fill #E3ECF6, neutral grey #BFBFBF. Column fills flat with no shadows or rounded corners. Callout circle outline 2pt grey, no shadow. Caption band #F2F2F2 flat rectangle with no border.

**Layout**

Single-slide chart page on a white field: small header line top-left and APOLLO wordmark top-right, large serif title left-aligned at top under the header with the chart occupying the lower two-thirds, the two column headers centred over their bars, multiplier labels in a right-hand column, and a small footnote block with page number 39 at bottom-right. Left margin about 3 percent, right margin about 3 percent.

**Visuals**

Stacked flow (Sankey-style) diagram comparing market-cap mix in 2014 and today. Left column: a single grey-blue stacked bar labelled 2014 MARKET CAP $2.3T, split from top to bottom into Banks 67%, Insurance 12%, Traditional asset managers 9%, Specialty finance 8%, Alternative asset managers 4% (the 4% segment is highlighted with a green box below the bar). Right column: a stacked bar labelled TODAY’S MARKET CAP $3.4T, split into Banks 62%, Alternative asset managers 12% (green), Insurance 10% (peach), Specialty finance 9% (warm grey), Traditional asset managers 6% (light blue). Curved translucent ribbons join each left segment to its matching right segment: grey-blue neutral band in the open space for banks, peach ribbon for insurance, light blue for traditional asset managers, warm grey for specialty finance, and a teal-green ribbon rising from the bottom-left Alternative asset managers segment to the top of the right 12% green segment. Right of the today bar, multiplier values are printed in a column: 1.5x (top, aligned with the header row), 1.4x (banks), 5.0x (alternative asset managers, inside a green outlined circle, the only highlighted point), 1.3x (insurance), 1.7x (specialty finance), 1.0x (traditional asset managers). A separate label ~4% CAGR sits at the top right of the column. No photographs, logos other than the APOLLO wordmark, or icons.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in a classical serif (Garamond-like, regular weight) black #000000, about 4.8 percent of slide height. Header line and APOLLO wordmark in small tracked-out capitals (sans for header, serif for wordmark), about 1.5 percent. Column headers in Segoe UI-like sans, year and TODAY’S in black at about 4.1 percent, MARKET CAP in grey #555859 tracked capitals at about 2.8 percent, totals in light sans about 5.2 percent. Segment labels in semibold sans (about 1.8 percent) coloured to match segments: BANKS #385878, INSURANCE #EC9A5F, TRADITIONAL ASSET MANAGERS #699ED1, SPECIALTY FINANCE #938679, ALTERNATIVE ASSET MANAGERS #007B63. Percentages in white semibold sans about 3.7 percent. Segment fills: banks #AFBBC8, insurance #F3C4A0, traditional asset managers #A9C8E6, specialty finance #C2BDB7, alternative asset managers #007B63. Ribbons are the same hues at low opacity (about 30 to 40 percent). Flat design with no shadows, no gradients, square corners on bars, 1 px white gaps between stacked segments. Circle around 5.0x is a 2 px green #007B63 stroke with white fill. Footnote in sans about 1.3 percent, black.

### Slide 44

**Review notes**

- Review: The argument connects well: returns on slide 5, a targets scorecard on slide 9, then market size, then the business case, with 'perception vs reality' framing on slides 20 and 44 and the originate-then-distribute logic on slides 54 to 66.
- Worth keeping: Keep the slide 5 and slide 9 chart-plus-callout treatment, the consistent section dividers with speaker names, and the before-and-after comparison layouts on slides 20, 44 and 52.

Column headings sit at y about 19.6% in two centred lines; boxed items stack below them, with the right column holding three stacked boxes, a downward chevron and a closing statement.

**Visuals**

Nine line icons in circular badges, arranged 3 columns by 3 rows. Left column (green line art, pale mint circles #EBF5F3): a steam locomotive (Railroads); a high-voltage electricity pylon (Rural Electrification); a road with a dashed centre line receding into hills (Auto Industry). Middle column (slate-blue line art, grey circles #E7EBEF): a globe with meridian and latitude lines (Globalization); a stack of banknotes with a dollar sign (Money Printing); a bar-and-line chart inside a framed panel with an upward arrow (Growing Valuations). Right column (blue line art, grey circles #E7EBEF): a wind turbine with a solar panel and wind lines (Energy Transition); a high-voltage electricity pylon (Power & Utilities); a computer microchip with pins on all four sides (Digital Infrastructure). Flat, no shadows, no photographs. A light grey (#F2F2F2) wave-shaped band fills the lower third behind the bottom labels, its top edge curving from about y 80% at the left, down to about y 80% at the centre, and up to about y 67% at the right.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a full-bleed light grey #F2F2F2 wave band across the lower third. Clean white background with a light grey (#F2F2F2) curved wave band across the lower third. Title in Garamond-style serif, regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height (cap height about 3.4%). Column headers in Segoe UI regular, about 5.9% of slide height, coloured green #007B63 (1890-1920), slate blue #385878 (1990-2020) and bright blue #3777B4 (2024+). Item labels in Segoe UI regular, black #000000, about 3.0% of slide height. Bottom labels in Segoe UI regular, about 4.3%, coloured #007B63, #385878 and #3777B4 for the question mark. Header and footer small text in Segoe UI, about 1.5% of slide height; 'APOLLO' in a letter-spaced serif capital. Thin grey horizontal rule (#C0C0C0, about 0.2% of slide height) under the headers. Circle badges have no outline or shadow, and icons are thin 1 to 2 px strokes in the matching accent colour.

**Layout**

Three-column composition on a white slide with a title at top left and a small running header above it. The centre column (Private Capital) is larger and sits higher than the two side columns, which are aligned to a common baseline near y 56 to 85. Each column has a circular icon, a heading, and a tinted panel holding three bullet rows with an icon at the left of each row. The header and the title are left-aligned at x 3.1 with a margin of about 3 percent. APOLLO is set top right at about x 92.5. The slide number 48 sits bottom right at about x 96, y 95.3.

**Visuals**

Three line icons and three status icon sets. Left: a green (#007B63) line icon of a bank building with a pediment, a circular emblem and four columns on a stepped base, inside a pale mint circle (#EBF5F3). Centre: a navy (#385878) line icon of two hands clasping in a handshake with three short radiating rays above, inside a pale grey-blue circle (#EDF0F3). Right: a blue (#3777B4) line icon of a framed bar chart with three vertical bars and a rising line with dots, inside a pale blue circle (#EDF3F9). Status icons are filled circles about 2.6 percent wide: a red (about #C9504B) circle with a white X, or a green (#007B63) circle with a white check mark. Left panel rows: red X next to Daily liquidity, red X next to Leveraged, green check next to Long-dated customer relationships. Centre panel rows: green check next to Long-dated capital, green check next to Unlevered, green check next to Deep client relationships. Right panel rows: red X next to Daily liquidity, green check next to Unlevered, red X next to Indexed and limited client relationships. No photographs. No chart axes.

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a small uppercase left header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' and a right-aligned small-caps 'APOLLO' at top, a large serif title at top left below the header, and a page number at bottom right. The main diagram is a centred cluster of interlocking gears spanning the middle of the slide, with 'TRADITIONAL' and 'APOLLO' section labels with underlines above it on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Diagram of seven gear shapes arranged as two groups. On the left (traditional), two grey gears stacked vertically: 'Primary Call' (upper) and 'Secondary Market' (lower), both labelled in dark grey text. On the right (Apollo), four coloured gears interlock with a large central gear: a large pale mint gear labelled 'Origination Platforms' containing a thin circular mint-green arrow (counter-clockwise loop with arrowhead at top) inside its ring; a pale blue-grey gear 'Corporate Direct Origination' to its right; a light grey-blue gear 'Sponsor Coverage' at upper right; a pale peach gear 'Bank Partnerships' below; and a pale aqua gear 'Client Partnerships' at lower right. Logos are placed on or beside the gears: WHEELS (blue wordmark with stylised W) and ATLAS SP (teal dotted-ring mark with dark navy wordmark) on the Origination Platforms gear; NewFortress energy (blue flame mark with navy wordmark) and AT&T (blue globe mark with black wordmark) near the Corporate Direct Origination gear; MidCap Financial (green X mark with blue wordmark) at the Origination Platforms edge; GRIDTEK UTILITY SERVICES (blue and green mark, wordmark) and pdc brands (dark grey wordmark with tagline) and rd (navy circle with white lowercase letters) at Sponsor Coverage; AIRFRANCE (red chevron and navy wordmark) below Corporate Direct Origination; ABInBev (yellow and dark blue wordmark) and intel (blue wordmark) and ADIA (brown-gold wordmark) near Corporate Direct and Client Partnerships; Redding Ridge Asset Management (navy and red emblem with grey text) and AirFinance (grey PK monogram with grey wordmark) at lower left of Origination Platforms; BNP PARIBAS (green square emblem with dark text), Citi (red arc and blue wordmark), AIMCo (navy wordmark), BCI (dark navy bold wordmark), and MUBADALA (teal emblem with grey spaced wordmark) around the lower gears. Lighting flat, no photographs, no shadows.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background, minimal flat graphic style. Title in a classical serif (Garamond-like), regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. Header and page number in a humanist sans (Segoe UI-like), regular, black #000000, about 1.5% of slide height. Section labels 'TRADITIONAL' in Segoe UI Semibold, slate blue #385878, and 'APOLLO' in Segoe UI Semibold, green #007B63, both about 2.8% of slide height with wide letter-spacing. Gear labels in Segoe UI regular about 3.3% of slide height: Primary Call and Secondary Market in grey #555859; Sponsor Coverage in slate blue #395878; Corporate Direct Origination in light blue #699ED1; Origination Platforms in green #007B63; Client Partnerships in teal #46A2B4; Bank Partnerships in orange #DE6C1A. Gear fills: #F3F3F1 (grey), #EDF0F3 (grey-blue), #F0F5FA (pale blue), #EBF5F3 (pale mint), #FBEBDF (pale peach), #E9F5F7 (pale aqua). Section underlines: grey-blue #D5DDE5 under TRADITIONAL and pale mint #C5E3DA under APOLLO, about 0.3% of slide height thick. The Origination Platforms ring is a thin mint #9ED3C2 stroke. No shadows, no rounded corners, no gradients.

**Layout**

Two-column comparison on a white slide. A small running head sits top left above a large title, with APOLLO top right. Each column has a light grey header bar with its name centred, a visual diagram beneath, and a 2x2 grid of tick or cross items. A thin vertical grey divider runs at the horizontal centre from below the headers to near the bottom. The page number sits bottom right. Margins are about 6 percent on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Left: a light grey-blue rectangle (#EDF0F3) containing the text Bank Retained Exposure, above a solid slate blue (#385878) bar labelled EQUITY, enclosed by a dotted slate blue outline; a short bracket line points to the text Only invest in equity tranche. Right: a dotted teal (#007B63) outline enclosing a vertical stack of five pale mint (#E4F2EF) bars labelled AAA, AA, A, BBB and BB, above a solid teal (#007B63) bar labelled EQUITY; a teal vertical bracket spans the stack with a short horizontal tick at its midpoint pointing to the text Ability to invest in all tranches of debt and the equity. Four red (#C00000) circled crosses mark No control, No alignment, High leverage and Counterparty issues on the left; four teal (#007B63) circled ticks mark Full control, Full alignment, Low leverage and No counterparty issues on the right. Each icon is an outlined circle about 3.2 percent of slide width with a stroke about 2 px. The ATLAS SP logo is a teal ring icon followed by a bold navy wordmark, placed inside the right header bar.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in Garamond regular, black #000000, about 4.8 percent of slide height. Running head INVESTOR DAY 2024 and APOLLO in small Garamond-style serif caps with letter spacing, black. Column headers in Segoe UI regular, slate blue #385878. Body labels in Segoe UI regular, black #000000, about 3.0 percent of slide height. Tranche labels in Segoe UI semibold, teal #007D55. Teal accents #007B63 on the right; slate blue #385878 accents on the left; red #C00000 crosses. Headline-style sans text in Segoe UI Semilight #007B63 for the right-hand callout. Square corners on all rectangles, no shadows, no gradients. Dotted outlines about 2 px.

**Layout**

Two horizontal bands stacked in the content area: a top band for Traditional Credit (light blue panel, five cards) and a lower band for Apollo Credit (light green panel, five cards in the upper row and two rows of eight cards below). Each band has a solid colour block at the left (x 5.7% to 21.6%) carrying the band title, followed by a triangular pointer notch that points right into the panel. Cards sit on a regular grid; the top row cards are centred in the panel at x 39.3% to 80.7%, and the lower grid spans x 27.7% to 92.6%. Header text INVESTOR DAY 2024 sits top-left at y 4.4% and the APOLLO wordmark top-right; page number 59 sits bottom-right at y 95.3%; margins about 3% left and right.

**Visuals**

Icon-and-label card set, all line-art or solid pictograms with no photographs. Top band (blue #3777B4 icons and labels on white cards): Loans, a hand holding banknotes; HY Bonds, an outlined cheque with a signature squiggle; IG Bonds, a classical bank building with pediment and columns; Emerging Market Debt, a solid globe showing Asia and Africa; CLOs, a curved arrow above three stacked rectangles. Apollo Credit band repeats the same five icons and labels in the upper row. Lower green band (#007B63 icons and labels on white cards), row 1: Preferred Equity, a rising line chart with arrow over an L-axis; CRE & RMBS, a cluster of office buildings; Equipment, an outlined tractor; Aviation, a solid aeroplane silhouette; Trade Finance, a cargo ship with containers; Media Rights, a presentation board with a play button; Infrastructure, a stylised forked road with a sign post; Direct Lending, a handshake. Row 2: Private Investment Grade, two outlined gears; Consumer, a credit card; Fleet, an outlined car; Sports Transfers, a tennis player with racket; Music Royalties, an acoustic guitar; Fund Finance, a stack of banknotes; Warehouse, a garage-style warehouse door with boxes; Distressed, a starburst outline. No charts, tables or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Top band panel #E1ECF6 at 50% opacity over white (reads as very pale blue #F0F5FB); top title block #699ED1 with a lighter triangle #D3E3F3 pointer. Apollo band panel #E8F4F1; title block #007B63; pointer triangle #B0D6CF at 70% opacity. Titles white #FFFFFF in Segoe UI Semilight (sans-serif, light weight), about 5.0% of slide height. Card labels in Segoe UI Bold, all caps, about 1.5% of slide height, blue #3777B4 in top band and green #007B63 in lower band. Header and page number in Segoe UI regular, about 1.5% of slide height, black #000000. APOLLO wordmark in a letterspaced serif capital face, black. Cards are flat white rectangles with no visible border, radius or shadow. No gradients.

**Layout**

Centred funnel diagram occupying the upper-middle of the slide, with four labelled circles inside a funnel outline and four text labels arranged two on the left and two on the right of it, all right-aligned on the left and left-aligned on the right. A grey down-pointing arrow sits below the funnel, and a full-width light grey band across the lower fifth carries the headline statement. The header text INVESTOR DAY 2024 sits at the top-left and the APOLLO wordmark at the top-right, with the footnote at bottom-left and the page number at bottom-right, all within margins of about 3 percent.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a light grey outlined funnel (ellipse rim at top, tapering to a rounded bottom) with a pale mint ellipse filling its upper opening; four solid circles and several small pale dots sit inside it. Circles: Private Markets (dark slate blue #385878, top-centre, label PRIVATE MARKETS in white), Public Markets (teal green #007B63, right of Private Markets, label PUBLIC MARKETS in white, overlapping the mint ellipse edge), Corporate Credit (mid grey #A6A6A6, lower left, label CORPORATE CREDIT in white, overlapping the funnel rim), Asset-Backed Finance (orange #EC9A5F, lower right, label ASSET-BACKED FINANCE in white). Labels around the funnel: upper-left Disciplined, Repeatable Investment Process; upper-right Sector Expertise; middle-left Emphasis on Downside Protection and Capital Preservation; middle-right Aligned Insurance Balance Sheet; lower-left Minimal Defaults and Losses; lower-right Strategic Investor Relationships. Small decorative dots of about 1 to 4 percent of slide width in pale mint and pale blue are scattered around the circles, with no values printed. Below the funnel, a solid downward block arrow in light grey #D9D9D9 (shaft on top, triangular head beneath, no outline). No charts, photographs or logos other than the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Sans-serif humanist typeface (Segoe UI family) throughout; circle labels and side labels in Segoe UI Semibold, the bottom statement in Segoe UI regular with the phrase best risk/reward in Segoe UI Bold. Header and footnote in Segoe UI regular. The APOLLO wordmark is set in a small serif capitals face with wide letter-spacing. Headline statement about 3.7 percent of slide height; side labels about 2.8 percent; circle labels about 2.4 percent; header and footnote about 1.3 to 1.5 percent. Title colours: no title; body labels dark grey #595959; statement black #000000 with accent #007B63. Shapes have flat fills, no shadows, no gradients, no corner radii on circles; the grey band is a flat rectangle with square corners. Funnel outline is a light grey stroke about 0.3 percent of slide height wide.

### Slide 64

**Review notes**

- Review: The argument connects well: returns on slide 5, a targets scorecard on slide 9, then market size, then the business case, with 'perception vs reality' framing on slides 20 and 44 and the originate-then-distribute logic on slides 54 to 66.
- Review: A few pages weaken the polish: the planet graphics on slide 13 put white numerals over busy textures, the title-less image slides 57 and 72 are hard to read without the speaker, and small footnotes and pie labels on slides 64 and 27 are tiny.
- Suggested repair: Replace the planet illustrations on slide 13 with a plain sized-bubble or bar layout so the numbers sit on a clean background and can be compared, and enlarge the labels on slides 27 and 64.

**Layout**

Two-panel layout on a white slide: a full-width light grey title band spans the top with the title centred inside it, and two header bars sit side by side below it, the left a light grey donut-chart panel (x 4.1 to 50.0%) and the right a dark blue panel (x 52.3 to 98.4%) above a scatter-style yield chart. A pale grey trapezoid connects the Fixed Income donut slice to the right chart. Small running head 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' sits top left and 'APOLLO' top right, with a four-line source footnote across the bottom left and page number 64 bottom right.

**Visuals**

Left: a donut chart titled 'Top 200 Pension Plan Average Allocations' with no legend; segments clockwise from top: Cash 2%, Other (unlabelled, about 1%), Private Credit 1%, Other Alt 9%, Non-US Equity 13%, Global Equity 7%, Fixed Income 22% (pulled out of the ring, highlighted in light blue #699ED1), US Equity 21%, Real Estate 10%, Private Equity 15% (orange #EC9A5F). Segment labels are placed on or beside each slice. Right: a scatter-style chart with vertical axis 'Yield' from 5% to 10% in 1% steps (ticks 5% to 10%) and horizontal rating axis AA, BBB, BB, B (categorical, no numeric scale). Points: Bloomberg U.S. Agg 5.3% at AA (about 5.3%, light grey-beige dot), Bloomberg Baa U.S. Corporate 5.9% at BBB (light grey-beige dot), Total Return IG 7.8% at BBB (orange dot #EC9A5F in dashed orange box), Total Return Fund 9.1% at BB (dark grey dot in dashed grey box), Credit Fund 9.3% at about B (dark navy dot #385878 in dashed navy box), Defined Return 10.3% at about B (light blue dot #699ED1 in dashed light blue box), ICE BofA U.S. HY Index 8.0% at about B (light grey-beige dot). Two dashed teal-green (#007B63) double-headed arrows: one vertical at BBB spanning from about 7.8% down to about 5.9% labelled as excess spread, one vertical at the B position spanning from about 8.0% up to about 10.3%. Axes are thin light grey lines; the Y axis runs from 5% to about 10.3% and the X axis is at 5%.

Two label boxes sit side by side along the bottom (y 78.8-88.9%), left box x 6.8-36%, right box x 43.4-93%, both aligned to the same margins as the painting. **Visuals**

Left: a cluster of 19 filled circles arranged in an irregular oval, about 4.5% of slide width each. Colours: bright green #00CC66 (about 6 circles), mid-dark green #339933 (about 8 circles), pale lime #CCFF99 (about 4 circles, drawn lighter). Circles are scattered without labels. A light warm-grey (#F4F3F1) wedge-shaped beam starts at the right edge of the cluster and widens to the right, its right end concave-curved at the cluster side, extending up and right to overlap the top-left corner of the painting. Right: a photograph of Georges Seurat's pointillist painting A Sunday on La Grande Jatte, in a rectangular frame with a thin purple-red border, shown uncropped, full-colour, dominated by yellow-green grass, dark green trees, blue water on the left, and purple-grey figures in the foreground. Figures include a woman with a parasol at centre, a man in a top hat seated at left, a woman in a dark dress with a black parasol at right, a child in white, and a dog at lower centre. Lighting is soft daylight. The beam overlaps the painting's top-left corner.

Label 'Our Perspective' in Segoe UI Semilight, teal-green #007B63, on a pale mint box #EBF5F2. Boxes are flat rectangles with square corners and no shadows. Beam is flat #F4F3F1 with no outline. Painting has a thin border, no shadow.

**Layout**

White slide with a large serif title spanning the top at left, a small header line 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' at top left and the word 'APOLLO' at top right, both with margins of about 3% and 4% from the slide edges. Two sub-headings sit at the same height below the title: the left heading over a two-bar-chart panel occupying the left half, and the right heading over a table in the right half, separated by a thin vertical grey rule at about x 50.5%, with a grey chevron between them at about x 51%. A small footnote block runs across the bottom from x 3% to 94%, with page number 78 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Two side-by-side bar charts and one table, plus a grey right-pointing chevron between the left panel and the table. Left chart 'CREATION MULTIPLES' (superscript 1): two vertical bars with category labels Industry Entry Multiple (superscript 2) and Apollo Entry Multiple; Industry bar is a tall pale mint #DEEEEB bar labelled 11-12x in green #007B63, Apollo bar is a shorter solid green #007B63 bar labelled 6-7x in white. A dotted grey reference line sits at the top of the Industry bar, and a grey arrow points up from the Apollo bar to it, with a white boxed callout reading ~5x Discount to Market in green. No numeric axes are printed. Middle chart 'LEVERAGE' (superscript 1): two vertical bars with labels Industry Entry Leverage (superscript 2) and Apollo Entry Leverage; Industry bar is a light grey #E7EBEF bar labelled ~6x in navy #385878, Apollo bar is a navy #385878 bar labelled 3-4x in white. A dotted grey reference line sits at the top of the Industry bar, a grey arrow points up from the Apollo bar, and a white boxed callout reads 2-3x Discount to Market in navy. Both charts sit on thin grey baselines and have no axes or legend. Right: a table with a red dotted rectangular border; header row 'As of Q2 2024' in black at left, and two shaded column headers Fund IX (~$25B, 2018 Vintage) with fill #F0F5FA and Fund X (~$20B, 2023 Vintage) with fill #E1ECF6. Rows: IRR (Gross / Net): Fund IX 29% / 20%, Fund X 47% / 20%; DPI (superscript 2) (Gross / Net): Fund IX 0.6x / 0.5x, Fund X 0.3x / 0.2x; Industry DPI (superscript 2) (Net): Fund IX 0.2x in italic, Fund X n/a in italic. **Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Title in a classic serif (Garamond-style), regular weight, black #000000, roughly 4.8% of slide height for the title. **Layout**

Two-column layout on a white field: a bar chart occupies the left column beneath the title area and a Key Highlights checklist occupies the right column, separated by a thin vertical grey rule at about 42.9% of the width. The title sits top-left at about 6.9% of the height, with a small uppercase header line above it at top-left and the APOLLO wordmark top-right. Left margin is about 3% and the right margin about 3%. The footnote block sits along the bottom-left at about 93.7% to 96.4% of the height, with the page number 81 at bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled 'Apollo Aligned Alternatives (AAA)' with subtitle 'NET ASSET VALUE (NAV)'. Chart type: stacked column chart with three categories and an upward grey arrow overlaid. No y-axis, no axis units and no axis ranges are printed. Series: Apollo Balance Sheet (dark green #007B63) and Third-Party Investors (light green #67B39A). Category 'Two Years Ago' (footnote 1, data as of June 30, 2022) shows one dark green bar labelled $8B, with the bar total of $8B printed above it; no third-party segment is shown. Category 'Today' (footnote 2, data as of June 30, 2024 including 3Q'24 anticipated subscriptions) shows a dark green Apollo Balance Sheet segment (about $12B, estimated from bar height) with a light green Third-Party Investors segment on top (about $6B, estimated), labelled $18B above the stack. Category 'Future' shows one solid navy bar (#385878) with no value printed, about 1.8 times the height of the Today stack. A light grey (#BFBFBF) straight arrow with a filled triangular head runs diagonally from just above the Two Years Ago bar up to just above the Future bar, indicating growth. Legend below the chart: dark green square labelled Apollo Balance Sheet, light green square labelled Third-Party Investors. Highlighted points: none beyond the arrow. Right column has eight check-mark icons: blue (#3777B4) check marks beside the first four highlights and orange (#DE6C1A) check marks beside the last three highlights; each check is a thin stroked tick about 2.4% of the width.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background, flat with no gradients or shadows. Title 'AAA: A Unique Product Driving Growth' in a Garamond-style high-contrast serif, regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. Highlight bullets in Segoe UI regular black about 2.8% of height. Axis category labels in Segoe UI regular black about 2.2%. Footnotes in Segoe UI regular black about 1.3%. Page number about 1.5%. ### Slide 85

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024
Our View
APOLLO
Today’s Perspective
Our Long-Term Vision
85

**Layout**

Title sits top-left under a small running header, with APOLLO top-right and page number bottom-right. Below the title, three pieces sit side by side on a horizontal axis: a small Seurat painting on the left (about x 8 to 34%, y 31 to 63%), a grey gradient wedge in the centre joining it to a large gallery photograph on the right (about x 46 to 90%, y 20 to 74%). Each picture has a caption centred beneath it, the left one in green at about y 68%, the right one in black at about y 79%. Margins are about 3% left and right; the header and title are left-aligned at x 3%.

**Visuals**

Three images and one gradient shape. (1) Photograph-style reproduction of a pointillist painting, Georges Seurat's A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte: a riverside park with many small figures in dotted brushwork, a woman in a long dark dress holding a dark parasol at centre right, a man in a top hat and seated figures on the grass, a black dog at lower centre, and a red parasol and boats on the water at left. Dominant colours are grass green, sage, olive and violet-blue. The image is a clean rectangle, not cropped, with no overlay or border beyond a thin edge. (2) Photograph of a museum gallery interior: a long room with light grey-taupe carpet, white and pale grey walls, a dark teal free-standing partition wall at left, grey pedestals holding sculpture (one with a white vase, one with a dark bronze object), many framed paintings on walls including a large gilt-framed canvas at right, track spotlights along the ceiling giving warm white light. Dominant colours are taupe, grey, teal and warm gold. Full rectangle, not cropped, no overlay. (3) Gradient wedge: a trapezoidal fill that is wider at the gallery end and narrower at the painting end, shading from mid grey near the painting to white at the gallery edge, linking the two images like a light beam or zoom.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with a minimal editorial look. Title in a classic serif (Garamond-style), black, regular weight, about 4.8% of slide height for the title cap-height region, sentence case. Running header and page number in a humanist sans (Segoe UI-style), regular weight, black, about 1.5% of slide height. Captions in Segoe UI-style sans, regular weight, about 4.45% of slide height: the left caption in green #007B63, the right caption in black #000000. Shapes have no outlines, no corner radius, no shadows; the wedge uses a linear grey-to-white gradient, mid grey near #BDBDBD fading to white #FFFFFF.

Two-column layout on a white field. Left column holds five centred statements, each followed by a centred green plus circle, stacked vertically with even spacing. Right column holds four rows, each a circular icon badge followed by a category label and a TAM range, with a large pale grey chevron pointing right between the columns. Title sits top-centre below the header band, in a single line. Header text at top-left, APOLLO wordmark at top-right, footnote bottom-left and page number 87 bottom-right, all at small size with margins of about 3 percent.

**Visuals**

Four line icons in circular badges on the right, plus five plus-sign circles in the left column, and one large pale grey chevron shape between columns. (1) Energy transition icon: green (#007B63) line drawing of a wind turbine at centre with wind swirl lines on the left and right and a solar panel array at lower left, inside a pale mint circle (#EFF7F5). (2) Power and utilities icon: slate blue (#385878) line drawing of a high-voltage electricity pylon with cross-bracing, inside a pale grey circle (#F3F5F7). (3) Digital infrastructure icon: blue (#3777B4) line drawing of a microchip with pin contacts on all four sides and an inner square, inside a pale blue circle (#F0F5FA). (4) Real estate icon: orange (#DE6C1A) line drawing of three office buildings of varying heights with window grids and doors, inside a pale peach circle (#FDF4ED). Plus circles: five identical pale mint circles (about #CDE8DF) each with a dark green (#007B63) thin-stroke plus sign, centred on the left column between the statements. Chevron: flat light grey (#F2F2F2) right-pointing chevron with its apex at the right, spanning from top to bottom of the content area, no outline or shadow. No photographs, charts or tables.

**Layout**

Two-zone slide on a white field: a left-to-right rising grey arrow across the left and centre, with a column of partner logos in a grid on the right (two logos per row, seven rows plus a centred Apollo wordmark). The title sits top-left below a small header line; the header and Apollo mark sit top corners, and the page number sits bottom-right at about 96% x. The Holistic Approach box is a bordered panel at lower centre; its eight bars are centred inside it. Left margin about 3% and right margin about 4%.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a pale grey (#EBEBEB) swoosh arrow rising from bottom-left (about x4 y84) to an arrowhead at upper-right (about x76 y17), with four stages marked on it. Stage 1: small orange dot (about x8.5 y63.5, diameter about 1.2% of width) with an orange vertical line up to the Traditional Model box, labelled FUNDS in orange caps. Stage 2: dark navy circle (#385878, about x22.5 y45.6, about 3.6 by 6.4) with a navy line down to the label Funds + Co-Invest; values are not printed, the circle is about the same size as the others. Stage 3: light blue circle (#699ED1, x38.7 y34.6, w5.0 h8.9) with a blue line up to the label Funds + Co-Invests + Directs + Strategic Partnerships + Knowledge Sharing. Stage 4: green circle (#007D55, x56.1 y27.5, w6.5 h11.5) with a green line down to the Holistic Approach box. Logos (16 raster images plus one vector wordmark): ADIA (gold-brown serif wordmark), GIC (navy vertical bars with GIC letters), Mubadala (teal emblem above spaced MUBADALA wordmark), ATLAS SP (teal icon with dark navy ATLAS SP), MassMutual (navy dots and bold navy wordmark), MIZUHO (navy wordmark with red underline swoosh), APOLLO | S3 Sponsor & Secondary Solutions (white serif wordmark on dark green-black banner), EMP BELSTAR (grey-navy text with divider), RSIC (navy shield icon and bold navy wordmark), SUMITOMO MITSUI TRUST BANK (teal-blue flower icon and blue caps), TRS (white on royal blue square, Teachers Retirement System of Texas), New York State seal (navy and gold circular seal), HOSTPLUS (white pixel-style mark on blue square), LORD ABBETT (tan square with white knight chess piece and dark caps), STATE STREET (blue stripes and bold blue caps), APOLLO Capital Solutions (green serif caps wordmark with grey Capital Solutions beneath). All logos are unboxed on white, sized to fit the grid, with no crop.

**Design**

Background pure white. Title in Garamond-style serif, regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height (cap height about 3.4%). Header and Apollo mark are small spaced serif caps in black about 1.5% of height. Body and labels in Segoe UI (sans-serif), regular weight: stage labels blue #3777B4 at 2.6% of height, navy #385878 for the Funds + Co-Invest label, orange #DE6C1A for Traditional Model and FUNDS, black #000000 for body text at 2.2%. Accent green #007D55 and text green #007B63 for APOLLO'S COMPREHENSIVE PARTNERSHIPS, Holistic Approach and bar labels in Segoe UI Semibold, letter-spaced caps at about 2.0% to 2.4% of height. Holistic Approach heading at 3.3%. Bars are pale mint #EBF5F3 with no outline. Grey arrow #EBEBEB, no shadows or gradients. Lines are 1 to 2 px, colour matching their stage. Traditional Model box has a 1 px orange #E8905A outline with square corners and white fill; Holistic box has a 1.5 px green #007D55 outline with square corners and white fill.

**Layout**

Four equal-width columns sit below a single left-aligned serif title, with the header line 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' at top left and the 'APOLLO' wordmark at top right. Each column has a centred coloured heading, a centred letter-spaced sub-heading, a coloured rule beneath, and a bulleted list; thin light-grey vertical dividers separate the columns. The footnote runs full width along the bottom-left margin, and the page number sits at bottom right; the left margin is about 3% and the right margin about 4%.

**Visuals**

None apart from the structural elements: three thin light-grey vertical divider lines between the columns, and four horizontal coloured rule bars under the sub-headings (dark slate blue under Wealth, mid blue under Retirement, orange under Institutional, warm grey under Capital Solutions). The rules are estimated, not measured. No photographs, charts, tables, diagrams, icons or logos other than the text wordmark APOLLO.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background (#FFFFFF) with no gradient or texture. Column headings are light-weight sans-serif (Segoe UI Semilight) in per-column colours: Wealth #385878, Retirement #3777B4, Institutional #DE6C1A, Capital Solutions #938679. Sub-headings are Segoe UI Semibold, all caps, letter-spaced, in the same column colours. Body bullets are regular Segoe UI in black #000000. The title is a high-contrast serif (Garamond, regular) in black, about 4.8% of slide height, with body text about 2.6% and sub-headings about 2.4%. Rules are flat with square ends, no shadows, and vertical dividers are hairlines.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white field: a narrow left column of three check-marked points and a wider right column holding a bar-style market chart, separated by a thin vertical grey rule at about x 41.7%. The title sits top-left below a small running header at the top-left, with four category tabs in a row across the top-right. Left-aligned text on the left, centred chart labels on the right; margins about 3% left and right; footnote bottom-left and slide number bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Three outlined check-mark icons in a vertical stack on the left, each a light blue (#6A9FD1-ish) circle of thin stroke with a check mark inside. Right side: a grey header panel with a downward-pointing grey wedge (triangle) under it leading to a bar chart with two columns on a thin light grey baseline. Column 1 labelled 2023 is a pale blue bar (#E3ECF6) about $24T, with the value label $24T above it in blue. Column 2 labelled 2028E is a mid blue bar (#699ED1) about $38T, with label $38T above it in blue. No y-axis, no gridlines, no axis units beyond the $ and T labels. A circle (white fill, light grey #BFBFBF outline) labelled ~10% CAGR sits between the bars with a grey connector line running from the 2023 bar to an arrowhead pointing toward the 2028E bar. Below the chart is a light grey plus sign (#D9D9D9) of thick strokes. No photographs, logos or icons other than the checks.

**Design**

### Slide 104

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / The Power of Our Capital Formation Machine / Capital Raising Then / Capital Raising Now / Capital Raising In the Future / $150B+ / ~$30 / ~$45 / ~$85 / $125B / $11 / $45 / $70 / $69B / $27 / $39 / 2019 – 2023 / Avg / LTM 2Q'24 / 2025E – 2029E / Avg Annual Target / RETIREMENT / INSTITUTIONAL / WEALTH / Note: Retirement figures represent Athene gross organic inflows. / 104

**Layout**

Three equal-width data columns sit under a title row, each with a light grey header band holding its heading, separated by thin vertical grey rules. The title is top-left at about 7% from the top with a small header label above it and the APOLLO wordmark top-right. A horizontal baseline runs under the three stacked bars, with category labels beneath, a centred legend row below them, and a footnote bottom-left with the page number bottom-right. Left margin about 3%, right margin about 3%.

**Visuals**

Chart: three stacked vertical bar charts sharing one baseline, no y-axis, no gridlines, no axis tick labels. Column 1 is titled Capital Raising Then with category label 2019 – 2023 / Avg and total $69B; segments from bottom: RETIREMENT $39, INSTITUTIONAL $27, WEALTH about $4 (unlabelled thin top segment, about 0.9% of slide height). Column 2 is titled Capital Raising Now with category label LTM 2Q'24 and total $125B; segments from bottom: RETIREMENT $70, INSTITUTIONAL $45, WEALTH $11. Column 3 is titled Capital Raising In the Future with category label 2025E – 2029E / Avg Annual Target and total $150B+; segments from bottom: RETIREMENT ~$85, INSTITUTIONAL ~$45, WEALTH ~$30. Bar widths are equal, about 15% of slide width each. Bar heights are proportional to totals: 2019 bar top about 57% of slide height from top, LTM bar top about 42%, 2025E bar top about 33%, all resting on the baseline at about 80%. Legend below the category labels: dark green square then RETIREMENT, mid green square then INSTITUTIONAL, light green square then WEALTH, all in uppercase sans-serif. No highlighted points.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white corporate investor-deck style. Titles in a Garamond-style serif, regular weight, black #000000. Column headings and all body and chart labels in Segoe UI-style humanist sans-serif, regular weight, black #000000. Totals in dark teal green #007B63 at large size. Segment value labels in white #FFFFFF. Series colours: RETIREMENT #007B63, INSTITUTIONAL #339582, WEALTH #99CAC1. Heading bands are flat #F2F2F2 rectangles with no border or radius. Title size about 4.8% of slide height, column headings about 3.7%, totals about 5.2%, body and labels about 2.4%, footnote and page number about 1.3-1.5%. Baseline and column dividers are thin light grey #BFBFBF lines. Bars have square corners, no shadow, no gradient.

### Slide 108

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Why Now? Starting the Fourth Institutional Revolution / FIXED INCOME / PUBLIC / EQUITY / FIXED / INCOME / ALTS / FIXED / INCOME / PASSIVE / ACTIVE / PRIVATE / CREDIT / FIXED INCOME / REPLACEMENT / ALTS / PASSIVE / EQUITY / REPLACEMENT / Foundations / 1930s–1980 / • Securities acts 1933-34 / • ERISA 1974 / • DB pensions emerge / Age of 60/40 / 1980s–2000 / • Volker breaks inflation / • Dotcom run-up / • 60/40 Portfolio / Barbell Portfolio / 2001–2024 / • Low return environment / • Shift out risk curve / • Alts and Passive / Replacement / Now / • Focus on Return/Risk / • Liquidity convergence / • Public -> Private / 8% TARGET RETURN / U.S. risk free rate 1 / Note: Portfolio allocations and target return shown are illustrative, based on views and opinions of Apollo Analysts. 1. Source: Federal Reserve. / 108

**Layout**

Single-slide grid of four equal columns across the upper-middle band, each with a pie chart, a coloured heading, a date line and three bullets; a full-width horizontal arrow labelled 8% TARGET RETURN sits below the columns, above a full-width line chart strip. Title sits top-left below the header line, left-aligned at about 3 percent margin; 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' is top-left and the APOLLO wordmark top-right, both at the top margin; footnote bottom-left and page number 108 bottom-right; column content is centred under each pie.

**Visuals**

Four pie charts in a row, plus a time-series line chart in a strip. Pie 1 (Foundations): a single full grey circle, #A6A6A6, labelled FIXED INCOME; no slices. Pie 2 (Age of 60/40): two slices, PUBLIC EQUITY in dark green #007B63 occupying about 60 percent of the circle (clockwise from 12 o'clock to about 5 o'clock), and FIXED INCOME in grey #A6A6A6 occupying about 40 percent (upper right); no axes, no values printed. Pie 3 (Barbell Portfolio): four equal quadrants, clockwise from upper left: ALTS orange #EC9A5F, FIXED INCOME grey #A6A6A6 (upper right), ACTIVE dark green #007B63 (lower right), PASSIVE light green #66B199 (lower left); no values printed. Pie 4 (Replacement): five slices clockwise from 12 o'clock: PRIVATE CREDIT slate navy #385878 (top left), FIXED INCOME REPLACEMENT grey #A6A6A6 (top right), PASSIVE light green #66B199 (right), EQUITY REPLACEMENT blue #3777B4 (bottom), ALTS orange #EC9A5F (left); slices are unequal and no values are printed. Labels are white uppercase inside each slice. Arrow: a horizontal double-headed arrow, grey #BFBFBF bar about 2.4 percent of slide height thick, arrowheads at both ends, with a white gap in the middle holding the text 8% TARGET RETURN. Line chart: thin grey (#7A7A7A approx.) time series of the U.S. risk free rate on a light grey #F7F7F7 panel with about 8 horizontal gridlines and grey vertical shaded bands marking recession periods; no y-axis or x-axis values printed; the line starts low at left, rises to a peak in the 1980s band (about the upper third of the panel), falls, peaks sharply near the 2000 band, then declines to near zero from about 2009 to the right edge, with a small rise near the end. Caption below the chart reads U.S. risk free rate with superscript 1 linked to the footnote.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.
