**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white field: a left column of two stacked stat blocks (x about 2 to 33%) and a right column holding a return-versus-risk diagram (x about 37 to 93%), separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about x 33.4%. The title sits top-left at about y 7%, below a small caps header at top-left and the APOLLO wordmark at top-right, with two-section headings WHAT: and WHY: at y about 18%. Left-aligned text with margins about 3% left and right; footnote bottom-left at y about 95% and page number bottom-right at x about 95.5%.

**Visuals**

Two stat callouts and one diagram. (1) Upper-left: a pale mint circle (#EBF5F3, diameter about 14.6% of slide width) containing the large teal numeral '$10B+' in Segoe UI Light (#007B63), with the body text to its right. (2) Lower-left: a pale blue circle (#E8F0F8, same size) containing a large blue numeral '9' in Segoe UI Light (#3777B4), with the body text to its right; no chart values. (3) Right: a diagram (not a data chart; no numeric axis ranges printed) with vertical axis labelled RETURN, grey arrow up, and horizontal axis labelled RISK, grey arrow to the right, both axis lines #A6A6A6 about 0.3% stroke. A light grey band (#F2F2F2) runs diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, bounded by a teal line (#007B63, about 0.4% stroke) on top running from about (37.5%,76%) to (77.6%,35.4%) and a red line (#CA504B, about 0.4% stroke) below running from about (37.5%,91.5%) to (93%,35.3%). Inside the band, the word Credit sits at lower-left and Equity sits at upper-right. A green filled circle (#007B63) labelled TODAY sits on the teal boundary at about (51.7%,52.9%) size 6.9 by 12.2%; a red filled circle (#CA504B) labelled LAST 20 YEARS sits on the red boundary at about (66.4%,52.9%) size 6.9 by 12.2%. Two grey dotted vertical drop lines (#808080) run from the bottom of each circle down to the x-axis. A grey dotted horizontal line at about y 58.9% runs across the diagram through both circles and continues to the right, ending at the 8% target circle. The 8% target circle is a white circle with a grey outline (#7F7F7F, about 0.3% stroke) at about (82.9%,52.1%) size 7.8 by 13.9%, reading 8% then RETURN TARGET in grey (#555859). A pale slate label box (#EFF2F5) at about (46.1%,37.9%) size 17.9 by 7.5% contains the word Replacement in slate navy (#385878), with a small pale teal upward triangle (#C8E3DD) beneath it pointing at the TODAY circle. Above the box, the caption Higher Return per Unit of Risk. Rotated about -30 degrees near lower-left, the label RISK-FREE RATE in grey, flanked by two small light grey arrowheads (#CFCFCF) pointing up-left and down-right along the band direction. No logos or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white corporate investor-deck style. Headline Garamond-style serif in black (#000000), regular weight, about 4.8% of slide height for the title. Section headings WHAT: and WHY: in Segoe UI Semibold, slate navy (#385878), caps, about 4.1% of height. Subheads Money is moving and LPs want return per unit of risk in Segoe UI regular black, about 4.4% of height. Body text Segoe UI regular black, about 2.8% of height. Accent colours: teal #007B63 for the $10B+ figure, the TODAY circle and the teal line; red #CA504B for the LAST 20 YEARS circle and red line; blue #3777B4 for the numeral 9; light blue #699ED1 bold for Investment Consultant; slate #385878 for headings and the Replacement label. Neutral greys #555859 for the 8% label and RETURN TARGET, #A6A6A6 for axes, #7F7F7F for the target outline. Line styles: thin solid grey divider, solid axes, dotted guide lines, solid coloured boundary lines. Circles are perfect circles with no shadows or gradients; the label box has square corners; no rounded corners, no shadows.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white field: a pie chart with a bracketed AUM total circle on the left half, and a two-bar chart on the right half. The title sits top-left, left-aligned at about 3% margin, below a small running header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' (left) and 'APOLLO' (right). Each column has a centred two-line subheading above its chart, and a thick rule sits under each column near the bottom. The source line sits bottom-left and the page number bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Left: pie chart with no title of its own (the column heading serves as title), four slices, no legend, values printed on slices. Slices clockwise from 12 o'clock: UHNW #8FB5DC labelled $49T; HNW #699ED1 labelled $40T; Accredited #395878 labelled $63T; Institutions #D9D9D9 labelled $145T (largest, occupies the left half of the pie). Slice labels are placed inside each slice, white text on the blue slices and #555859 on the grey slice. Pie is a flat solid-colour pie with no outline, no shadow, centred in its column. Bracket to the right of the pie: thin light-blue #B4CDE6 line, 1.5 pt, with a vertical stem at about x 45% from y 31% to y 79% and short horizontal ticks to the left at top and bottom, joined to a circle outlined in the same light blue (about 1.5 pt) containing '~$150T AUM' in blue #3777B4; the circle is filled white. Right: bar chart with no title, no legend, no axis labels, no gridlines. Two bars on a thin grey #BFBFBF baseline: Institutions bar #D6E4F2 (very pale blue) labelled 23% above it, about 23% height relative to a full-column scale; Global Wealth bar #699ED1 labelled <3% above it, short bar (under 3%). Bars are flat rectangles with no outline. Category labels below baseline in bold capitals: INSTITUTIONS and GLOBAL WEALTH. No highlighted points beyond bar colour difference.

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF with no gradient or texture. ### Slide 123

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / We Are Playing to Win Big / ~$30B / AUM BY / YE 2024 / 2021–2024 / Expand client coverage and expertise / Scale solutions & platforms / Foundational thought leadership / 5x / 2024–2026 / Private markets provider of choice / Marquee strategic partnerships / Top 3 global wealth market share / Service infrastructure & excellence / >$150B / TARGET AUM BY / YE 2029 / 2026–2029 / Accelerated market expansion / New pools of capital / Expanded private & public solutions / Lending & financing / …Through Innovation and Commitment to Needs of Global Wealth Investors / 123

**Layout**

Three-stage growth arrow across the upper-middle of a white slide, with three columns of stage content stepping upward from left to right. The title sits top-left at about 6.9% from the top, the running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 sits above it at top-left, the APOLLO wordmark sits top-right, and the page number sits bottom-right. Left margin is about 3.2% and right margin about 3.1%. A full-width light grey band at the bottom carries the closing line, and the page number sits below it.

**Visuals**

Five-part graphic on white. (1) A wide pale grey (#F2F2F2) curved arrow rising from lower-left to upper-right, with a pointed arrowhead at the upper right, running behind the three circles. (2) A solid green (#007B63) circle at left containing ~$30B in white with AUM BY YE 2024 below it in white capitals. (3) A green-outlined white circle in the centre containing the large green numeral 5x, with no label. (4) A solid light blue (#699ED1) circle at upper right containing >$150B in white with TARGET AUM BY YE 2029 below it in white capitals. (5) Dotted light grey (#BFBFBF) step line: a horizontal dotted segment under 2021–2024 from the left margin to about 33.7% across, rising by a vertical dotted segment at about 33.7% to a horizontal dotted segment under 2024–2026 running to about 66.3%, rising by a vertical dotted segment to a horizontal dotted segment under 2026–2029 that ends in a small solid grey right-pointing triangle at about 95% to 97% across. No photographs, icons or logos.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white corporate slide. Title in a Garamond-style serif regular, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. Running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 in small spaced SegoeUI capitals, black. APOLLO in small serif capitals, black. Body text in Segoe UI regular (black #000000) with key phrases in Segoe UI Semibold in stage colours: green #007B63 for stage 1, slate blue #385878 for stage 2, mid blue #3777B4 for stage 3. Stage dates set in Segoe UI Semibold, about 3.3% of slide height, coloured to match each stage. Body text about 2.6% of slide height. Bullets are small black ArialMT dots. Arrow and band fill #F2F2F2, circles solid or outlined with no shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners on the grey band.

**Layout**

The title sits top-left below a small running header at about y 4 to 12%, left-aligned at a margin of about 3% from the left edge. Thin grey horizontal rules separate the tiers at about y 36, 58.5 and 81%; a row of four checkmark items sits at the bottom, and a footnote sits bottom-left with the page number bottom-right at about x 95.5%.

**Visuals**

Diagram/infographic with no photographs. Tier 3 (New Frontiers, numbered circle 3, dark blue #385878): three 3D-style raised blocks in dark blue #385878 with a lighter top face and darker right side face, labelled Defined Contribution, Tax-Advantaged and Mass Affluent, each with a caption below. Tier 2 (Scaling Client Base, numbered circle 2, mid blue #699ED1): four 3D-style blocks in mid blue #699ED1 with lighter top faces and darker right side faces, labelled Independent Wealth, Global Family Office, APAC Wealth and EMEA Wealth, each with a caption below. Tier 1 (Foundation, numbered circle 1, green #007B63): one wide 3D-style block in green #007B63 with a lighter green top face #329582 and darker right side, labelled Private Banks & Wirehouses, spanning from about x 27.7 to 96.8%, with the caption +$10B OF CAPITAL RAISED IN ~3 YEARS and superscript 1 below it. Numbered circles are flat filled circles (dark blue for 3, mid blue for 2, green for 1) with white numerals. Bottom row: four outlined circles (stroke green #007B63, about 0.3% of slide width stroke, unfilled) each containing a green checkmark, followed by the labels. No numeric chart values. No logos or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in black #000000 Garamond regular serif, large (about 4.8% of slide height). Running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 and APOLLO wordmark in small black serif/sans caps. Bottom labels Segoe UI Semilight black about 3.2% of slide height. Grey band #F2F2F2. Shapes are sharp-cornered with simple 3D bevel-like extrusions (top face lighter, side face darker) and no shadows or gradients. Grey rules thin, about #BFBFBF.

### Slide 126

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / A Diversified Global Platform / Ecosystems / CREDIT / EQUITY / REAL ASSETS / Asset / Classes / Investment Grade / Private Equity / Real Estate / Direct Origination / AAA / Sustainability / Asset Backed / Hybrid Value / Infrastructure / European Private Credit / Secondaries / Opportunistic Credit / Diversified Private Credit / Products / Offered Directly / to Wealth / 9 / 5 / 5 / 30+ Global Vehicle Access Points | Co-Investments | Sub-Advisory / 126

**Layout**

Three-column grid of ecosystem columns (Credit, Equity, Real Assets) set to the right of a left label column, with a vertical grey rule separating each row label from its content. The title sits top-left below a small running header; the APOLLO wordmark sits top-right and the page number bottom-right. A full-width light grey strip sits near the bottom as a takeaway bar, with the slide number below it.

**Visuals**

Three colour-coded column header bars (Credit dark green, Equity slate blue, Real Assets light blue) each with a stack of rounded-free rectangular asset-class tiles beneath: Credit has six tiles (Investment Grade, Direct Origination, Asset Backed, European Private Credit, Opportunistic Credit, Diversified Private Credit), Equity has four (Private Equity, AAA, Hybrid Value, Secondaries), Real Assets has three (Real Estate, Sustainability, Infrastructure). Below them are three filled circles with white counts: 9 (green, Credit), 5 (slate, Equity), 5 (light blue, Real Assets). Three thin grey vertical divider lines separate row labels from content. No photographs, icons or charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with clean sans-serif body text and a light serif display title. Title in black #000000 Garamond regular, about 4.8 percent of slide height. Row labels in black #000000 Segoe UI Semilight about 4.1 percent. Column header labels in white #FFFFFF Segoe UI Semibold, all capitals, letter-spaced, about 3.2 percent. Tile labels in Segoe UI regular about 2.6 percent, coloured to match their column: green #007B63, slate #385878, blue #3777B4. Tile fills are very pale tints: #EBF5F3 for Credit, #EAF0F6 for Equity, #EDF3F9 for Real Assets. Circle counts in white Segoe UI Semilight about 5.9 percent. Takeaway bar text in black Segoe UI about 3.3 percent. Divider lines are light grey, about #BFBFBF, hairline. Shapes have square corners, no shadows or gradients.

### Slide 134

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Our Right to Win – Why Athene Has Been Able to Grow Consistently and Take Share / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / Asset / Outperformance / Cost Structure / Scale / Product / Distribution / Capital / Culture & / Management Team / Target 30-40bps of outperformance across portfolio / Outperformance via differentiated origination, illiquidity and structure / Credit quality and credit losses have been better than the industry1 / 35bps Opex2 advantage vs industry / Athene wholesaler productivity is ~3.5X the national avg3 / Diverse product suite across four major channels / Multiple Access points via: / – Banks / – Broker Dealers / – IMO / – Institutional / – Capital Markets / Fortress Balance Sheet and strong ratings profile / Largest sidecar in Retirement Services industry (ADIP/ACRA) / High performance culture that drives innovation / Top tier executive management team / Distinguished 21st century model of premier insurer and asset manager / 1. Athene's statutory fixed income impairments adjusted to include changes in mortgage loan specific reserves in relation to average invested assets of regulated entities in the U.S. and Bermuda. Industry average represents U.S. statutory impairments adjusted to include changes in mortgage loan specific reserves per SNL Financial. Industry average includes AEL, AMP, BHF, CRBG, EQH, FG, LNC, MET, PFG, PRU, VOYA and Transamerica. 2. Figures are U.S. statutory G&A divided by average total U.S. statutory assets from 2019 to 2023. Industry includes: Allianz, Corebridge, Global Atlantic, Mass Mutual, MetLife, Nationwide, New York Life, Pacific Life, and Prudential. 3. Source ISS Market Intelligence YTD June 30, 2024. / 134

Column headers in light blue-grey sans-serif sit on one row at about 16% from top, separated by a grey plus sign and two grey equals bars; thin grey vertical dividers at about 31% and 70% of width run from 31% to 89% of height. The slide title is set at top left at about 7% from top with a left margin of about 3%; a small running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 sits top left and APOLLO top right at about 4.5% from top. The footnote block sits bottom left across the width from 92% to 96% of height; the page number 135 sits bottom right at about 95%.

**Visuals**

Donut chart: segmented ring with centre label $302B (large grey numerals with $ prefix). Segments clockwise from top: Corporate & Gov't 42% (dark green #007B63, large arc on right side), CLO 10% (navy #385878, bottom right), ABS 11% (orange #EC9A5F, bottom), CML 12% (light blue #699ED1, bottom left), RML 9% (taupe #938679, left), RMBS 3% (light taupe #CAC2BA, upper left), CMBS 3% (grey-blue #889BAE, upper left), Alternatives 5% (dark grey #555859, top left), Cash and Equivalents 3% (mint green #66B199, top), Other 2% (pale blue #8FB5DC, top right, footnote 1). ATHENE bar in navy #385878 labelled 11 bps above it (superscript 4 on ATHENE label). Icons: three identical outline circles with check marks, navy #385878 strokes of about 2 px, no fill, placed beside the three bullets. **Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Cost Structure/Scale: Athene is Highly Efficient / Expense / Ratio / 2019-2023 / 67 bps / 35 bps / 32 bps / INDUSTRY AVG.1,2 / ATHENE 1,3 / Total / Employees / 2023 / ~18,500 / INDUSTRY AVG.4 / ATHENE / ~2,000 / Earnings / Per Employee / 2023 / $1.6M / $0.3M / INDUSTRY AVG.4,5 / ATHENE6 / 1. Figures are U.S. statutory G&A divided by average total U.S. statutory assets. 2. Industry includes: Allianz, Corebridge, Global Atlantic, Mass Mutual, MetLife, Nationwide, New York Life, Pacific Life, and Prudential. 3. Athene’s average other operating expenses on a GAAP basis from 2019-2023 were 25bps. 4. Industry includes: Corebridge, Global Atlantic, Mass Mutual, MetLife, Nationwide, New York Life, Pacific Life, and Prudential as of or the year ended December 31, 2023 or latest publicly available information. 5. Peer earnings per employee calculated as pre-tax operating earnings divided by employee headcount as of December 31, 2023 or latest publicly available information. 6. Athene’s earnings per employee is calculated as spread related earnings divided by employee headcount as of December 31, 2023. / 136

**Layout**

Three equal columns of bar-chart panels separated by thin vertical grey rules, under a single left-aligned title near the top. Small header text sits top left with the APOLLO wordmark top right; three footnote lines run across the bottom left with the page number bottom right. Left margin is about 3% of width and the title sits at about 7% from the top.

**Visuals**

Three bar charts with no axes or gridlines. Chart 1 'Expense Ratio 2019-2023': bars for INDUSTRY AVG. (light grey, labelled 67 bps) and ATHENE (dark blue, labelled 32 bps); an oval callout with black outline between them reads 35 bps, with a black arrow pointing from the industry bar label down to the Athene bar label. Chart 2 'Total Employees 2023': INDUSTRY AVG. light grey bar labelled ~18,500 (tall) and ATHENE dark blue bar labelled ~2,000 (short). Chart 3 'Earnings Per Employee 2023': INDUSTRY AVG. light grey bar labelled $0.3M (short) and ATHENE dark blue bar labelled $1.6M (tall). No legend, no axis ranges, no highlighted points beyond the dark Athene bars. Bars sit on thin grey baselines; bar heights are proportional to the labelled values in each panel.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF with flat styling and no gradients or shadows. Titles in a light sans-serif (Segoe UI Semilight) in steel blue #385878. Body and labels are regular Segoe UI in black #000000 for header, footer and bar labels; chart values are in steel blue #385878. Title is a black Garamond-style serif at about 4.8% of slide height, column headers about 5.0%, values about 3.3%, footnotes about 1.3%. Bars are square-cornered; light bars #EDF0F3, dark bars #385878. Oval callout has white fill and black outline. Vertical dividers are thin light grey.

Note: Metrics are as of or for the last twelve months ended June 30, 2024. 1. Relates to Athene’s primary insurance subsidiaries; represents ratings from AM Best "A+", Fitch "A+", S&P "A+" and Moody’s "A1". 2. Computed as capital in excess of the capital required to support our core
operating strategies, as determined based upon internal modeling and analysis of economic risk, as well as inputs from rating agency capital models and consideration of both NAIC RBC and Bermuda capital requirements. 3. Includes $3.0 billion in excess equity capital, $3.3 billion in
untapped leverage capacity and $3.8 billion in available undrawn capital at ACRA. Untapped leverage capacity assumes an adjusted leverage ratio of not more than 30%, subject to maintaining a sufficient level of capital required to maintain our desired financial strength ratings from rating
agencies. 4. Represents the aggregate capital of Athene’s U.S. and Bermuda insurance entities, determined with respect to each insurance entity by applying the statutory accounting principles applicable to each such entity. Adjustments are made to, among other things, assets and

### Slide 140

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Capital: Rating Agencies Have Consistently Recognized Athene’s Strong Capital / Position / $35 / $33 / $23 / $19 / $18 / $15 / $13 / $10 / $9 / $6 / $4 / $2 / AM Best / Financial / Strength / Rating / A++ / A+ / A+ / A+ / A / A+ / A+ / A / A / A+ / A+ / A- / Regulatory Capital Backing Reserves ($B)1 / 140 / Note: Athene data as of June 30, 2024. Peer data as of December 31, 2023. 1. Represents the aggregate capital of Athene’s U.S. and Bermuda insurance entities, determined with respect to each insurance entity by applying the statutory accounting principles applicable to each / such entity. Adjustments are made to, among other things, assets and expenses at the holding company level. Includes capital from the non-controlling interests in ACRA as well as ~$4B of undrawn, on-demand equity capital in ADIP. For peers, regulatory capital is U.S. / statutory total adjusted capital plus Bermuda total adjusted capital and exclusive of all non-U.S. and Bermuda regulatory capital.

**Layout**

A single-column slide with a small header row at top (INVESTOR DAY 2024 left, APOLLO right) and a two-line serif title left-aligned at the top margin. Below the title, a row of twelve vertical bars rises from a common baseline with a value label above each bar, a logo and an AM Best rating under each bar, and a full-width light grey band carries the chart caption; a small footnote and page number 140 sit at the bottom.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled Regulatory Capital Backing Reserves ($B) with superscript 1 in a grey band beneath the plot. Twelve bars, left to right, with printed values: MassMutual $35 (A++), Athene $33 (A+, highlighted in pale blue), Prudential $23 (A+), MetLife $19 (A+), Corebridge $18 (A), Manulife $15 (A+), Pacific Life $13 (A+), Lincoln $10 (A), Global Atlantic $9 (A), Principal $6 (A+), RGA $4 (A+), Talcott $2 (A-). Value axis is not drawn; bar heights are proportional to the printed values, baseline at about 57.8% of slide height. Under the axis line, each bar has a logo and its AM Best Financial Strength Rating printed in the row labelled AM Best Financial Strength Rating. Highlight: the Athene bar is pale blue #E1ECF6 with its value $33 and rating A+ in blue #699ED1 (bold italic rating), all other bars are warm light grey #F4F3F1 with values in dark grey #404040 and ratings in black italic. Bars are flat with no outline, no shadows, and no gridlines. A thin light grey horizontal axis line runs under the bars across the chart width (about #BFBFBF, estimated). Logos from left: MassMutual wordmark (dark navy), Athene Holding (blue swoosh mark with grey HOLDING sub-text), Prudential (blue globe mark with wordmark), MetLife (blue and green M mark with wordmark), corebridge financial (purple dotted mark, wordmark), Manulife (green bars mark, wordmark), Pacific Life (blue wave emblem with PACIFIC LIFE wordmark), Lincoln Financial Group (dark red shield-like mark, wordmark), Global Atlantic Financial Group (blue and green mark, wordmark), Principal (blue P mark, wordmark), RGA (bold red letters), Talcott (navy and orange mark, wordmark). No photographs or illustrations.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a single full-width light warm grey band #F4F3F1 behind the chart caption. Title in a light, regular-weight high-contrast serif (Garamond), black #000000, sentence case, about 4.8% of slide height per line. Header INVESTOR DAY 2024 in letter-spaced caps sans (Segoe UI), black, about 1.5% of height. APOLLO wordmark in letter-spaced serif caps, black. Value labels in Segoe UI Semilight, about 3.3% of height, dark grey #404040 (Athene #699ED1). Ratings in Segoe UI Italic, about 2.8% of height, black (Athene bold italic blue #699ED1). Band caption in Segoe UI regular, about 3.2% of height, black. Footnote in Segoe UI regular, about 1.3% of height, black. Bars are flat with square corners, no gradients, no shadows.

142

**Layout**

Single-column composition on a white field with a title at top left under a small header line, a grey callout box and two pale circular stat badges in the upper-left half, and a full-width stacked area chart filling the lower two-thirds. The header ‘INVESTOR DAY 2024’ sits at top left and ‘APOLLO’ at top right, the title sits at left margin around 7% from top, the source line sits at bottom left and the page number at bottom right, with margins of roughly 3% on each side.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked area chart, three filled series drawn back to front from the baseline: lightest #E1ECF6 band (bottom, labelled 58 million in 2023), mid-blue #699ED1 band (middle, labelled 74 million in 2035), and dark slate #385878 band (top, labelled 82 million in 2050). X axis titled Age Distribution, ticks every 5 from 40 to 100, no unit printed. Y axis titled Retiree Population (Millions), no tick values printed, so heights are unlabelled except the band labels. Curves are jagged with the dark band peaking near age 78 (about 1 unit above the mid-blue peak at about age 72), and the bands thin to near zero at ages 40 to 50 and at age 100. No legend, no highlighted points beyond the three band labels. Two pale circular stat badges (#E1ECF6) with large text: +40% expected increase, and ~11K Americans. Grey callout arrow box (#F2F2F2) with a #D9D9D9 right-pointing triangle.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Title in Garamond regular, black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. ### Slide 143

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / …That is Woefully Unprepared for Retirement / AMERICA'S RETIREMENT CRISIS IN 3 STATS / MASSIVE NEED FOR RETIREMENT INCOME / 1 / 75% / of retiree households have income below $75,000 / 2 / ~50% / of American workers do not participate in a retirement plan / 3 / >1/3 / of pre-retirees are concerned about running out of money in retirement / ~$4T / Estimated Retirement Savings Gap in the U.S. / Source: LIMRA: “The Retail Retirement Reference Guide” and Deloitte 2023 Retirement Investors: Behaviors, Attitudes, and Financial Situations. / 143

**Layout**

Three-row stat ladder on the left half: numbered circles 1, 2, 3 at the left margin, each beside a pale teal figure box and a two-line caption. A grey header box sits above the stats and a green header box above a large circle on the right, separated by a grey right-pointing chevron. The title sits top-left at the left margin, with the kicker above it and APOLLO top-right; the source line is bottom-left and the page number bottom-right, both at small size.

**Visuals**

Three numbered stat rows and one large callout, all as text on flat shapes, with no photographs or charts. Row 1: a pale teal #F2F8F7 box containing the figure 75% in light green type beside the caption. Row 2: the figure ~50% in the same style. Row 3: the figure >1/3. Each numbered circle is a thin pale mint outline ring around a green numeral. A grey #EBEBEB right-pointing triangle spans the height of the stats, with its tip pointing toward the right-hand circle. Above the circle, a light grey #E6E6E6 downward triangle hangs from the green header box. The large circle is a thin mint #A8D5C8 outline, about 3 px, enclosing the green text ~$4T; it is a plain ring with no fill, sitting on a white rectangle.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

### Slide 148

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Organic Engine Has Consistently Generated Profitable Growth… / Gross Organic Inflows / ($B) / $70 / $63 / $48 / ~23x / $37 / $28 / $18 / $13 / $9 / $11 / $4 / $3 / $37 / 1H’24 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / 2017 / 2018 / 2019 / 2020 / 2021 / 2022 / 2023 / 2024E 1 / RETAIL ANNUITIES / FLOW REINSURANCE / PENSION GROUP ANNUITIES / FUNDING AGREEMENTS 2 / 1 / 2 / 148 / 1. Previously announced target of $70 billion or more of estimated inflows in FY'24. 2. Funding agreements are comprised of funding agreements issued under Athene's FABN program, secured and other funding agreements, funding agreements issued to the FHLB and long-term / repurchase agreements.

**Layout**

Single full-width chart slide on a white field. Small kicker top-left and APOLLO wordmark top-right sit on a common top margin of about 4.4% of the height; the left-aligned serif title sits below at about 6.9% from the top with a left margin of about 3.1%. The vertical stacked-bar chart fills the middle band from about 17% to 75% of the height, with a horizontal baseline at about 72.6%, year labels beneath it, a legend row at about 81%, a two-line footnote at about 93.7% to 96.5%, and page number 148 at bottom right (about 95.5%, 95.3%).

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked vertical bar chart titled 'Gross Organic Inflows' with unit subtitle '($B)'. Eleven bars, one per year 2014 to 2024E, left to right, sitting on a thin light-grey baseline. Printed totals above bars: 2014 $3, 2015 $4, 2016 $9, 2017 $11, 2018 $13, 2019 $18, 2020 $28, 2021 $37, 2022 $48, 2023 $63, 2024E $70 (the 2024E bar is hatched grey, labelled as the previously announced target). No value axis or gridlines are printed. Segment values are not printed; segment heights are approximate. Stack order bottom to top: Retail Annuities (dark green), Flow Reinsurance (dark slate blue), Pension Group Annuities (mid blue), Funding Agreements (orange). Legend below the baseline in that same order with square swatches. Callout: white ellipse with black outline containing '~23x' at about 44.5% to 52.5% x, 39.4% to 45% y, with a black arrow running diagonally from just above the 2014 bar up to the top right of the 2024E area, showing growth. Bracket: thin black right-facing bracket spanning the 2024E solid (non-hatched) portion, labelled '$37' and '1H’24'. Approximate 2024E segments: retail about $25B, flow about $4B, pension about $1B, funding about $7B, all about values.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title text black #000000 in a classic serif (Garamond-style), regular weight, about 4.8% of slide height for title caps height, with the word 'Profitable' underlined. Kicker and APOLLO wordmark in small widely letter-spaced serif caps black #000000. Chart labels and legend in SegoeUI-style humanist sans, regular weight, black #000000 values and #111111 year labels. Colour accents: retail green #007D55, flow navy #385878, pension blue #699ED1, funding orange #EC9A5F, and dark teal #007B63 for the 2024E retail segment. Flat fills with no gradients, shadows or rounded corners. Thin black arrow line and black ellipse outline about 0.2% of height thick.

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Market Leadership in Retail Annuities, with Continued Opportunity for Growth / ~$120B Cumulative Retail Inflows Over Past Decade / Athene’s Retail Annuity Franchise is The Market Leader2 / #1 / Rank for / Total / Annuity / Sales / #1 / Rank for / Fixed / Annuity / Sales / #1 / Rank in / the Bank / Channel / #1 / Rank in / the IMO / Channel / 5 of Athene’s Current Top 6 Distributors Added Within Last 5 Years / PNC / TRUIST / LPL Financial / WELLS FARGO / J.P.Morgan / 2019 / 2020 / 2022 / 2023 / $39 / 12%1 / 9% / $21 / 6% / $8 / 6% / $7 / 5% / $5 / 3% / $3 / 2014 / 2016 / 2018 / 2020 / 2022 / LTM 2Q'24 / RETAIL ANNUITY INFLOWS ($B) / FIXED ANNUITY MARKET SHARE / Note: Fixed annuity market share per LIMRA for the years presented. 1. Fixed annuity market share per LIMRA for the six months ended June 30, 2024. 2. Industry rankings per LIMRA for the year ended December 31, 2023. / 151

**Layout**

Single white slide with a serif title across the top under a small header line at upper left and a wordmark at upper right. Below the title the slide is split into two columns by a thin vertical grey divider at about x 49.0 percent: the left column holds a bar-and-line chart with its heading and legend; the right column holds a 2x2 grid of ranking circles with captions above a row of four logo tiles with years. A footnote runs along the bottom left and the page number sits at bottom right, all on a common left margin near 3 percent and right margin near 96 percent.

**Visuals**

Chart (left): combined bar and line chart titled ~$120B Cumulative Retail Inflows Over Past Decade. Categories on the x axis: 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, LTM 2Q'24. Series 1, Retail annuity inflows ($B), shown as pale mint bars with labelled values: $3, $5, $7, $8, $21, $39. Series 2, Fixed annuity market share, shown as a dark grey line (about #595959) with labelled values: 3%, 5%, 6%, 6%, 9%, 12% (the 12% carries superscript 1). The bar and line labels are placed directly on the marks; no y axis or gridlines are printed, so the value scales are not shown. Legend beneath the chart: a mint swatch followed by RETAIL ANNUITY INFLOWS ($B), and a dark grey line swatch followed by FIXED ANNUITY MARKET SHARE. No point is highlighted beyond the latest bar and point. Right column: four identical pale blue-grey circles (#F0F5FA) each holding a blue #1 numeral in #3777B4 light sans-serif; no icons. Below them, a row of four square logo tiles (#F3F5F7) with logos: PNC (orange circular mark with navy PNC wordmark), Truist (navy hashed-square mark above navy TRUIST wordmark, stacked under PNC in the first tile), LPL Financial (navy stacked-bar mark above navy serif LPL Financial wordmark), Wells Fargo (white WELLS FARGO serif capitals on a red #E31B23 square), J.P.Morgan (dark grey serif J.P.Morgan wordmark). Tile years beneath, in #385878: 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023. Thin vertical rule in light grey separating the columns.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background (#FFFFFF). Main title in a Garamond-style serif, regular weight, black #000000, about 4.8 percent of slide height. Header kicker INVESTOR DAY 2024 in small SegoeUI caps, black, letter-spaced, about 1.5 percent. Section headings in SegoeUI Semibold black #000000 about 2.6 percent. Ranking captions in SegoeUI regular black about 2.8 percent. Years in SegoeUI regular #385878 about 3.3 percent. Chart labels in SegoeUI, green #007B63 for bar values, white for hidden labels, dark grey #555859 for line values. Accent colours: mint #E7F3F1, pale blue #F0F5FA, blue #3777B4, navy #385878. Shapes are flat with no corner radius, shadow or gradient; the tiles are square-cornered and the circles are perfect ellipses. Divider line is a thin light grey vertical rule.

### Slide 152

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Retail Distribution Has Evolved Significantly and is Still Expanding / Multi-year distribution expansion effort within Financial Institutions / Opportunity for further expansion as additional / relationships come online and existing relationships season / RETAIL INFLOWS BY DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL / 100% / 2014 / 12% / 38 active / IMO distributors / 14% / 2019 / 74% / 26% / 2024 / 1 / 55% / 19 active / Bank distributors / 19% / 148 active / Broker Dealer distributors / BANK / BROKER-DEALER / IMO / 1. Retail inflows by distribution channel YTD June 30, 2024. / 152

**Layout**

Single white slide with a full-width header row: small letter-spaced 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' at top left and 'APOLLO' wordmark at top right, with the serif title left-aligned beneath at about 7% from the top. Two check-marked statements sit in two columns in the upper band, followed by a light grey panel spanning about 3% to 97% of the width that holds the panel heading at top left and three donut charts in a row with grey block arrows between them and a centred legend along the panel bottom; footnote at bottom left and page number 152 at bottom right, both on the left and right margins of about 3%.

**Visuals**

Three donut charts, no axes, no legend box inside the charts; a shared legend sits below them. Donut 1, 2014: a single full ring of IMO dark slate blue #3E596C labelled 100% at the top of the ring, centre label 2014. Donut 2, 2019: ring starting at 12 o'clock and running clockwise, Bank segment #007D55 labelled 12% (about 43 degrees), Broker-Dealer segment #699ED1 labelled 14% (about 50 degrees), IMO segment #3E596C labelled 74% (about 266 degrees); centre label 2019. Donut 3, 2024: ring starting at 12 o'clock clockwise, Bank segment #007D55 labelled 55% (about 198 degrees), Broker-Dealer segment #699ED1 labelled 19% (about 68 degrees), IMO segment #3E596C labelled 26% (about 94 degrees); centre label 2024 with superscript 1; annotations in italic: 38 active IMO distributors above the IMO segment, 19 active Bank distributors to the upper right of the Bank segment, 148 active Broker Dealer distributors below the Broker-Dealer segment. Between donuts, two light grey #D9D9D9 right-pointing block arrows with a rectangular shaft and triangular head. Legend below the panel: green #007D55 square labelled BANK, light blue #699ED1 square labelled BROKER-DEALER, slate #3E596C square labelled IMO. Two grey check-mark icons in light grey #F2F2F2 squares at the top of the slide next to the statements. No photographs, no highlighted points.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF background with a light grey #F2F2F2 panel behind the charts.

**Layout**

Two-column layout split by a thin vertical grey divider at about 57% of the slide width, with a left column headed Launch / Scale New Products (four cards) and a right column headed Unlock New Markets (three cards). The slide title sits top-left below a small running header, a grey takeaway band spans the full width near the bottom, and the page number sits bottom-right, with consistent margins of about 3% on the left and 4% on the right.

**Visuals**

Two diagram-style graphics. Left: an inverted funnel shape (one light blue trapezoid tapering into a rectangular stem, fill #E3ECF6) labelled “Widening the Funnel”, with a thin blue connector (#A9C8E8, about 0.4% of slide height) running from the stem bottom down to a horizontal bus that drops into the tops of four cards (International Markets, Grow RILA Market Share, Structured Settlements, Stable Value Market). Right: a six-blade camera aperture icon made of pale green petals (fill #DEEEEB) spanning about x 71.4–83.4% and y 20.8–42.7%, labelled “Opening the Aperture”, with a pale green connector (#9ED3C4) running from the icon bottom down to a horizontal bus that drops into the tops of three cards (Tax Advantaged, Guaranteed Income, Defined Contribution). Each card has a small downward-pointing triangle below its heading (light blue #C5DAEE on the left, pale green #CCE8E0 on the right), roughly 4.5% wide and 2.6% tall, centred under the heading. No photographs or logos other than the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Titles in black (#000000) serif title (Garamond-style, regular weight), column headings in sans-serif SegoeUI regular in slate blue #385878 (left) and green #007B63 (right). Card headings in SegoeUI regular in blue #3777B4 (left) and green #007B63 (right). Subtitles in SegoeUI semibold italic in matching colours. Body text in SegoeUI regular black #000000, centred. Main title about 4.8% of slide height; column headings about 4.4%; card headings about 3.2%; body text about 2.3%; takeaway line about 3.7%. Cards are plain rectangles with no visible border, no corner radius and no shadow. Left cards #F0F5FA, right cards #F2F8F7. Takeaway band is a flat #F2F2F2 rectangle with no border. Connectors are flat lines with square ends, no shadows, no gradients.

Behind the bars, alternating period panels: Accelerated Growth panel #E1ECF6 spanning Pre-2009 to 2014, Measured Growth panel #F2F2F2 spanning 2015 and 2016, Accelerated Growth panel #E1ECF6 spanning 2017 and 2018, Measured Growth panel #F2F2F2 spanning 2019 and 2020, Accelerated Growth panel #E1ECF6 spanning 2021 to 2023. Each period has a header label and a horizontal rule above it: blue #699ED1 for Accelerated Growth and dark brown #6E6154 for Measured Growth. A grey ellipse #F4F3F1 at upper left holds the callout 18% Average Annual Pre-Tax ROE since 2013. Below the bars is a row of five ROE cells with a dashed orange outline: 31% (blue cell over Pre-2009 to 2014), 14% (light grey cell over 2015 and 2016), 16% (blue cell over 2017 and 2018), 14% (light grey cell over 2019 and 2020), 18% (blue cell over 2021 to 2024E). No legend is shown; no points are highlighted beyond the period colouring. No logos, photographs or icons are present apart from the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with no gradient or texture. Titles are black #000000 Garamond regular, sentence case, at about 4.8 percent of slide height. Body and labels are Segoe UI sans-serif. Value labels are regular weight in warm grey #938679; period headers are semibold in blue #699ED1 for Accelerated Growth and brown #6F645A for Measured Growth; the 18% callout is semibold #6E6154. Year labels are regular #595959 at about 2.2 percent of slide height. ROE values are semibold navy #385878 in blue cells and #6F645A in grey cells, about 4.1 percent of slide height. Accent for the ROE row label is orange #EC9A5F. Panels and cells are flat fills with square corners, no shadows. Header rules are about 3 px thick. The ROE dashed frame is orange #E8914F with dashes. Baseline is a thin light grey #BFBFBF line.

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024
APOLLO
As Owners, We Do Not Seek to Maximize Near Term Profits or ROE in a Given Year
In practice, we…
1
Hold Billions More
of Excess Equity
Capital
To be OPPORTUNISTICALLY
POSITIONED to capture wide
spreads and maintain fortress
balance sheet
2
Actively Manage
Portfolio to Benefit
Long-Term
By DYNAMICALLY RE-ALLOCATING
back book and front book to capture
safe yield and move up in quality
3
Exercise Discipline in
Context of Profitable
Growth
By not growing for growth’s sake,
we TOGGLE PRICING AND
VOLUME within growth channels
to generate target returns

**Layout**

Three equal full-width columns in a band spanning the slide from roughly 28% to 68% of the height, each column a solid colour block with a large numeral, heading and below it a body paragraph on white. Small header line at top left with APOLLO at top right, title below the header spanning the width, subtitle 'In practice, we…' at left under the title; page number 159 bottom right. Left margin about 3% of width.

**Visuals**

Three adjacent solid rectangles forming a band with no gaps: column 1 dark green, column 2 slate blue, column 3 light blue. No photographs, icons or charts. Each rectangle holds a large light numeral (1, 2, 3) with a heading in white beneath it.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title in black #000000 Garamond serif regular, about 4.8% of slide height. Subtitle in black #000000 Segoe UI Semilight sans-serif, about 5.6% of height. Column numerals and headings in white #FFFFFF Segoe UI Light/Semilight, numerals about 12% of height, headings about 5% of height. ### Slide 169

**Text**

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Citizenship and The Apollo Opportunity Foundation / Bringing together social impact and employee development on deal teams / Career Education / Workforce Development / Economic Empowerment / FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS / National Education Equity Lab / FROM LITTLE THINGS BIG THINGS GROW clontarf foundation / अवन्ती Avanti Fellows / IntoUniversity / APPRENTICESHIP / GAIN Girls Are INvestors / girls who invest / girls who code / ENTREPRENEURSHIP / The Acceleration Project / Move Forward. ETIC. Entrepreneurial Training for Innovative Communities / FINANCIAL LITERACY / TEAK FELLOWSHIP / Student Leadership Network / EXPANDED PATHWAYS / BRAVEN / POINT FOUNDATION THE LGBTQ SCHOLARSHIP FUND / The Vedica Scholars Programme for Women / Generation 香港 HONG KONG / LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT / THE HONOR FOUNDATION / CAREER PREPARATION / iJAG / PROJECT TOWN / ANY / FUTURES AND OPTIONS The Future is in Your Hands / RESKILLING & UPSKILLING / PER SCHOLAS / The Marcy Lab School / ACCESS TO CAPITAL / echoing green / Ownership Works / Data as of August 31, 2024. / 169

**Layout**

Three equal columns with a bold section heading at the top of each column, separated into horizontal bands by thin rules; each column contains three subsections (Career Education: Foundational Skills, Financial Literacy, Career Preparation; Workforce Development: Apprenticeship, Expanded Pathways, Reskilling and Upskilling; Economic Empowerment: Entrepreneurship, Leadership Development, Access to Capital). The serif title sits top-left below the small caps running header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024', the wordmark APOLLO sits top-right, and the subtitle sits left below the title. The footer note is bottom-left and the page number bottom-right, with about 3 percent left and right margins.

**Visuals**

Logo grid, no charts, photographs or diagrams. Column one, Career Education: Foundational Skills shows the National Education Equity Lab logo (red upward-trend arrow icon above red wordmark NATIONAL EDUCATION and grey EQUITY LAB) top-left, the clontarf foundation badge (square with a black silhouette figure and the words FROM LITTLE THINGS BIG THINGS GROW, a red-orange and yellow block) with the clontarf foundation wordmark, the Avanti Fellows logo (yellow and red sunburst icon with Hindi wordmark and AVANTI FELLOWS) and the IntoUniversity logo (black wordmark with red iu arrow badge). Financial Literacy shows the TEAK FELLOWSHIP logo (letters T E A K in purple, yellow, green and purple, with FELLOWSHIP spaced below) and the Student Leadership Network logo (black outline book icon with yellow and blue band and bold black wordmark). Career Preparation shows the iJAG logo (blue graduation cap over grey iJAG block), the PROJECT TOWN circular badge (navy and blue ring with CAREER text), the ANY logo (blue, orange and red circular swoosh with ANY text) and the Futures and Options logo (orange circle with door icon, black FUTURES AND OPTIONS and orange tagline). Column two, Workforce Development: Apprenticeship shows the GAIN logo (multicoloured yellow, teal and blue head silhouette with teal GAIN and Girls Are INvestors), girls who invest (teal lowercase wordmark with registered mark) and girls who code (teal blocky lettering). Expanded Pathways shows the BRAVEN logo (red circular icon with black wordmark), the POINT FOUNDATION logo (navy wordmark with mortarboard icon and THE LGBTQ SCHOLARSHIP FUND), the Vedica Scholars Programme for Women logo (orange mandala circle with serif text) and the Generation Hong Kong logo (blue handwritten Generation with blue underline and 香港 HONG KONG). Reskilling and Upskilling shows the PER SCHOLAS logo (blue mortarboard icon, navy PER SCHOLAS wordmark) and The Marcy Lab School logo (teal interlaced glyph with navy wordmark). Column three, Economic Empowerment: Entrepreneurship shows The Acceleration Project logo (two overlapping pale blue and dark blue circles, black THE ACCELERATION PROJECT) and the ETIC logo (red dot-grid circle icon with Move Forward. ETIC. and a small red full stop). Leadership Development shows THE HONOR FOUNDATION logo (navy shield with three white stars and vertical stripes, navy wordmark). Access to Capital shows the echoing green logo (bright green lowercase wordmark) and the Ownership Works logo (red square with white circle and chevron icon, black Ownership Works wordmark). All logos are flat, unshadowed and boxed only by their own artwork on white.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background #FFFFFF with no gradient, texture or photography. Main title in Garamond regular, black #000000, about 4.8 percent of slide height (cap height about 3.4 percent). Subtitle in Segoe UI Semibold, black #000000, about 2.6 percent. Running header and footer text in Segoe UI regular, black #000000, about 1.3 to 1.5 percent, with the header letter-spaced caps. Column headings in Segoe UI regular, about 3.9 percent, coloured green #007B63 (Career Education), blue #3777B4 (Workforce Development) and orange #DE6C1A (Economic Empowerment). Subsection labels in Segoe UI Semibold, all caps, letter-spaced, about 2.0 percent, in the same column colour. Thin horizontal rules of about 0.1 percent height in pale tints of each column colour, light teal under Career Education, light blue under Workforce Development and light orange under Economic Empowerment. No rounded corners, shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Two-tier layout on a white field: a row of five circles with operators (+, –, –, =) across the top half, with two sub-captions beneath the first two circles, a thin grey horizontal rule at about 50% of slide height, and two bar-chart panels below (PII at left, Performance Fee-Eligible AUM at right). The title sits top-left at about 7% from the top with a small running header above it and the APOLLO wordmark top-right; the slide number sits bottom-right; left margin about 3%.

**Visuals**

Operator-and-circle equation row: five light grey (#EFF1F1) circles of equal size, four with labels in blue text and one filled medium blue (#8FB5DC) with white text. Between them are grey (#BFBFBF) operator glyphs: a plus sign, two minus bars and an equals sign.

Left chart: bar chart titled PII with two bars and no axis labels. Bar 1 is pale blue (about #A9C5E5), labelled $350M above it, with category label 2020 - 2024E / AVG. Bar 2 is blue (#699ED1), labelled ~$900M above it, with category label 2025E - 2029E / AVG ANNUAL TARGET. A grey (#BFBFBF) circle outline with white interior sits between the bars, containing ~2.5x, with a grey straight line running from the circle's lower-left to near bar 1 and a grey arrow with filled triangular head running from the circle's upper-right toward the top of bar 2. Baseline is a thin grey line. Bar heights are proportional: bar 2 is about 20 times the height of bar 1 in the drawing.

Right chart: bar chart titled Performance Fee-Eligible AUM with three blue (#699ED1) bars, no y-axis and no axis titles, no gridlines. Values printed above bars: 2020 $134B, 2022 $180B, 2Q'24 $213B. Category labels below baseline: 2020, 2022, 2Q'24. Baseline is a thin grey line. Bar heights are proportional to the printed values.

No photographs, logos or icons other than the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with no gradient or texture. Titles in black (#000000) Garamond-style serif (regular weight, about 4.8% of slide height for the main title). Section titles PII and Performance Fee-Eligible AUM are blue (#699ED1) in Segoe UI Semilight at about 4.1% of slide height. Circle labels are blue (#699ED1) Segoe UI regular at about 3.3%. Chart values are black Segoe UI at about 3.0 to 3.3%. Category labels are black Segoe UI, all caps for the sub-labels, with wide letter-spacing, at about 2.0%. Running header and page number are small Segoe UI at about 1.5%. Shapes are flat with no shadows, no rounded rectangles, circles fully round. Thin rule and axis lines are about 1px grey (#BFBFBF).

**Layout**

A full-width comparison table with a row-label column at left (about x 3 to 33 percent) and two equal value columns (Fund IX at x 33.2 to 58.2 percent, Fund X at x 58.3 to 83.3 percent), with the table spanning about y 20 to 85 percent. The slide title sits top-left at y 6.9 percent in a single line spanning about x 3 to 88 percent, with the small running header INVESTOR DAY 2024 at top-left and the APOLLO wordmark at top-right above the title line; all text is left-aligned to a left margin of about 3 percent, the footnote block sits at the bottom left (y 92 to 96 percent) and the page number 180 sits bottom-right at about x 95.5 percent.

**Visuals**

None apart from the comparison table. Table: 3 columns (row label, Fund IX, Fund X) and 5 body rows plus a two-line column header row. Column header Fund IX: name 'Fund IX', subtitle '~$25B' (fund size, the B set in smaller capitals), and '(2018 Vintage)' in italics. Column header Fund X: name 'Fund X', subtitle '~$20B', and '(2023 Vintage)' in italics. Row 1 'Deployment': Fund IX 'Fully Invested', Fund X '~50% Committed'. Row 2 'IRR (Gross / Net)': Fund IX '29% / 20%', Fund X '47% / 20%'. Row 3 'Industry IRR (Net)' with superscript 1: Fund IX '16%' with caption 'industry benchmark'; Fund X 'n/a'. Row 4 'DPI (Gross / Net)' with superscript 2: Fund IX '0.6x / 0.5x'; Fund X '0.3x / 0.2x'. Row 5 'Industry DPI (Net)' with superscript 2: Fund IX '0.2x' with caption 'industry benchmark'; Fund X 'n/a'. No chart, no photographs, no icons. Rows 1, 2 and 4 in the value columns are shaded light blue; rows 3 and 5 are light grey. Cell rules are thin light-grey horizontal lines and the header rule is a dark navy line.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white slide with no gradient, texture or imagery. Titles and running header are black (#000000) in a Garamond-style high-contrast serif; the title is regular weight and large (about 4.8 percent of slide height). Table column headers are semibold sans-serif in light blue #73A2D3 (Segoe UI Semibold style), about 3.7 percent of slide height. Subtitles and vintage labels are regular and italic in #73A2D3 at about 2.2 to 3.0 percent. Row labels are semibold black sans-serif (about 3.3 percent); parenthetical sub-labels are italic black. Values are regular black sans-serif at about 3.7 percent; industry-benchmark values are italic black and their captions are italic at about 2.0 percent. Shaded value cells: #E3ECF6 (light blue) for rows 1, 2 and 4; #F3F3F3 (light grey) for rows 3 and 5. Header rule is a thin navy line (#1F4E79) across the table width; row separators are thin grey lines (#BFBFBF). Shapes are square-cornered with no shadows. Footnote and page number are regular black sans-serif at about 1.3 percent.

**Layout**

Two equal columns beneath a full-width serif title at top left, with a small all-caps running header at top left and the APOLLO wordmark at top right. The left column holds a ruled table with a grey-filled total row, and the right column holds a line chart with its heading and a y-axis at left. Margins are about 3% on the left and right. The footnote runs across the bottom above the page number 185 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Chart: line chart titled SRE Net Spread ex notables(2) (%), with y-axis from 0.0 to 2.0 in steps of 0.2 (unit %) and categorical x-axis 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 1H'24. One series in slate grey-blue line #8A9BB0 about 2 pt wide with no markers. Labelled values: 2014 1.41; 2015 1.25; 2016 1.24; 2017 1.31; 2018 1.38; 2019 1.22; 2020 0.92; 2021 1.53; 2022 1.31; 2023 1.44; 1H'24 1.35. Values are printed above or below each point in #385878. A dotted horizontal average line in #385878 at 1.31 runs across the plot, labelled AVG 1.31% in bold #385878 at right. No legend. No highlighted points. Table: left-hand table with two columns, label and value, under the header UNDERWRITTEN SRE NET SPREAD ON 1H'24 NEW BUSINESS. Rows: Asset Yield 6.5%; Cost of Funds (5.3%); Opex (0.2%); Product Spread 1.0%; Return on Capital, Wrap Fee, less Financing Costs 0.4%; SRE Net Spread ~1.4%. Horizontal rules in mid grey #8C8C8C about 1 pt separate rows. The total row has a very light grey #F3F5F7 label cell and a pale blue-grey #DBE2E7 value cell. No photographs, logos or icons.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Titles in dark navy-black #000000 serif (Garamond-style) for the main title, and blue-slate #385878 sans-serif light for the two section headings. Body text is black #000000 in Segoe UI regular for values and dark grey #404040 for row labels; row labels for subtotals are Segoe UI Semibold in #385878. Main title is about 4.8% of slide height, section headings about 4.4%, chart and table values about 2.6% to 3.0%, labels about 2.2%, footnotes about 1.3%. Lines are thin grey rules with no corner radii, shadows or gradients. Layout is flat with no decorative shapes.

**Layout**

Single white slide with a large serif title across the top left at about 7% from the top, starting at x 3.1%. Two panels sit side by side and are separated by a thin vertical grey divider at x about 50.7%: on the left, a pie-chart pair with a grey arrow between them; on the right, a column chart with a grey ‘Net Returns’ band below it. Panel headings are left-aligned at about 16.5% from the top. A footnote block sits at the bottom from x 3.1% and a page number is at bottom right (x 95.5%, y 95.3%). Header label at top left and APOLLO wordmark at top right.

**Visuals**

Chart 1, 2Q’24 pie: a pie with three slices, starting at 12 o’clock and running clockwise. Navy #385878 slice about 70% (labelled ~70%), light blue #699ED1 slice about 20% (labelled ~20%), grey #BFBFBF slice about 10% (labelled ~10%). No axes or legend on the pie itself; the shared legend sits below it. Chart 2, PRO-FORMA pie: navy #385878 about 80% (labelled ~80%), light blue #699ED1 about 10% (labelled ~10%), grey #BFBFBF about 10% (labelled ~10%). Between the two pies is a light grey #E6E6E6 right-pointing triangle, with a thin blue-outlined rectangle labelled ATHORA & VENERABLE above its tip region. Chart 3, LTM 2Q’24 column chart (Alts Performance Illustration, net returns, no axis): Athene Alts Portfolio Actual column in grey #889BAE valued 7.3%; Pro-forma Illustration column in navy #385878 valued 9.1%. Chart 4, Trailing 3Y annualized column chart: Athene Alts Portfolio Actual in grey #889BAE valued 9.8%; Pro-forma Illustration in navy #385878 valued 11.2%. Columns share a baseline at about 74% from the top; values printed above each column and no gridlines or y-axis. Legend (bottom left): navy square #385878 labelled APOLLO ALIGNED ALTERNATIVES (“AAA”); light blue square #699ED1 labelled RETIREMENT SERVICES PLATFORMS; grey square #BFBFBF labelled OTHER. Superscript 1 follows PRO-FORMA under the right pie; superscript 2 follows PRO-FORMA ILLUSTRATION under both bar groups. No photographs or logos other than the APOLLO wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white background. Titles and headings are black #000000 (the main title is in a serif Garamond-style face, regular weight; panel headings are SegoeUI Semibold). Body and labels are Segoe UI, regular or semilight, in black #000000, with all-caps letter-spaced labels. Accents are navy #385878 (pie labels, bar headings, Net Returns text), mid blue #699ED1 (Athora & Venerable box and text, legend), and greys #BFBFBF, #889BAE, #E6E6E6, and #F3F5F7. Left margin about 3%, right margin about 3%; the 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' label sits top left, the APOLLO wordmark top right, the footnote bottom left and the page number bottom right.

**Visuals**

Non-photographic. One elbow connector: a thin grey-blue (#889BAE) line leaves the right edge of the Illustrative Re-Based 2023 SRE row ($2.8B) at about y 52.7%, runs right to x about 33%, turns up to y about 30%, then runs right to a solid filled triangular arrowhead pointing right into the Re-Based 2023 SRE row at x about 36.5%. Two green plus signs (#0A7A5A, bold, about 4% wide) sit beside Organic Business Growth and Portfolio Optimization in the 2025 column, and one red minus bar (#C00000, about 4% wide, about 0.8% thick) sits beside Interest Rate Impact. **Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with no gradient or texture. Thin grey row dividers (#BFBFBF, about 0.1% thick) separate rows. Highlight fills are flat, square-cornered and without shadows: #EFF3F7 for the 2023 total row and #EDF3F9 for the Estimated 2024 SRE row.

**Layout**

Single white slide with a left-aligned serif title at top left under a small caps kicker INVESTOR DAY 2024, and an APOLLO wordmark at top right. Line chart with no y-axis and no gridlines, titled only by the slide title. Highlighted points: the 2024E open ring, the 2026E navy dot and the 2029E open ring.

**Design**

Accent colours: green #007B63, light green #99CAC1, navy #385878, callout tint #EFF7F5, neutral grey #BFBFBF. **Layout**

Five equal columns sit in the middle band of the slide, separated by four thin vertical grey rules that run from about 24% to 83% of the slide height. The title is left-aligned at the top under a small running header at top left, with the APOLLO wordmark at top right. Each column holds a centred numbered circle, a centred multi-line heading, a check-mark icon and a centred status line; a small footnote runs along the bottom left with the page number at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Five small graphic elements: a light grey (#EDEDED) right-pointing chevron/triangle wedge sitting centred on the vertical divider between the two columns, spanning about y 41% to 66%, pointing right; three pale blue (#EEF4FA) filled circles at the right edge of the uses column (one per use row, centred on the row, about 5.8% wide by 10.2% tall) each holding a '~$7B' value; and three light grey (#BBBBBB-ish) right-pointing arrows (thin shaft with solid triangular head) between each use label and its circle. Note: We have updated the reporting of our Asset Management Strategies to Credit and Equity, from the previously reported Yield, Hybrid and Equity, which better reflects our Asset Management Investment Strategies. Prior periods have been restated to conform to current presentation.

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a small header row at top: 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' at top left and 'APOLLO' at top right, then a large serif title left-aligned below. The body is three columns: a pale blue left panel holding the rotated-free heading 'Mgmt. Fees & Contribution', a Legacy Reporting chart block in the centre, and a Go Forward Reporting chart block on the right, separated by a thin vertical grey divider; each chart block has a dashed-outline LTM column on its far right. A footnote runs along the bottom left and the page number sits bottom right.

**Visuals**

Two side-by-side combined charts with identical structure. Left chart titled 'Legacy Reporting' with subtitle '$ in millions'; right chart titled 'Go Forward Reporting' with subtitle '$ in millions'. Each chart has a top line chart and a bottom 100% stacked column chart. Line series (Management fees, $ in millions, no printed axis): 2019 $1,491, 2020 $1,647, 2021 $1,878, 2022 $2,134, 2023 $2,480, 2Q'24 LTM $2,607; markers are dots joined by straight segments, the 2Q'24 LTM point is labelled $2,607. Legacy line is dark grey #55585A; Go Forward line is green #007B63. Stacked columns, each totalling 100% with the total printed above each column: Legacy segments bottom to top Yield, Hybrid, Equity: 2019 54%/7%/39%; 2020 58%/8%/34%; 2021 62%/10%/28%; 2022 66%/10%/24%; 2023 65%/10%/26%; 2Q'24 66%/10%/24%. Go Forward segments bottom to top Credit, Equity: 2019 63%/37%; 2020 67%/33%; 2021 70%/30%; 2022 69%/31%; 2023 68%/32%; 2Q'24 70%/30%. Legacy colours: Yield #55585A, Hybrid #949999, Equity #DBDEDE. Go Forward colours: Credit #007B63, Equity #66B199. Column labels sit inside segments, white on dark segments and black on light ones. Category axis labels under each chart: 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2Q'24, with a thin grey baseline. Legend under each chart: Legacy shows Yield, Hybrid, Equity swatches; Go Forward shows Credit and Equity swatches. The 2Q'24 column in each chart is inside a dashed grey LTM box marked 'LTM' in bold at top. No value axis or gridlines. No photographs, logos or icons other than the text wordmark APOLLO.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white corporate slide with no decoration. Title in a high-contrast serif (Garamond-like, regular weight) in black #000000, about 4.8% of slide height. Header label 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' is a small sans-serif (Segoe UI-like, regular, all caps) in black #000000 at about 1.5% of height. APOLLO wordmark is a small serif capitals with wide letter spacing in black. Section headings Legacy Reporting in Segoe UI Semilight #2A2C2C, Go Forward Reporting in Segoe UI Semilight #007B63, about 3.3% of height. Subtitles '$ in millions' are Segoe UI Semilight Italic about 2.0%. Data labels Segoe UI regular about 2.0% (totals) and 1.7% (segment labels). Left panel heading Mgmt. Fees & Contribution in Segoe UI Semilight black about 4.1% of height, set on three lines. Shapes are flat with no shadows or gradients; the LTM boxes are dashed grey outlines (#A6A6A6, about 0.4% stroke) with pale fills, the Legacy fill #F4F3F1 at 35% opacity and the Go Forward fill #CCE5E0 at 35% opacity. Vertical divider is a thin grey #BFBFBF line. Footnote Segoe UI about 1.3% of height in black.

Single-column slide on white with the title top-left at about 3% margin and a small running header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' above it; 'APOLLO' wordmark sits top-right and the slide number 199 bottom-right. The body is two side-by-side stacked bar charts (Legacy Reporting left, Go Forward Reporting right) separated by a thin vertical grey rule at about 58% width; a left column of two pale-blue row labels (Fee Generating AUM, AUM) spans the chart rows. Each chart has 2019 to 2023 plus a dashed-outlined 2Q'24 column at the right, and a note and totals line sit along the bottom margin at about 94 to 96% height.

1. Equity-based profit sharing expense and other includes certain profit sharing arrangements in which a portion of performance fees distributed to the general partner are required to be used by employees of Apollo to purchase restricted shares of common stock or is delivered in the form of RSUs, which are granted under the Equity Plan. Equity-based profit sharing expense and other also includes performance grants which are tied to the Company’s receipt of performance fees, within prescribed periods, sufficient to cover the associated equity-based compensation expense. 2. Special equity-based compensation and other charges includes equity-based compensation expense and associated taxes related to the previously announced special fully vested equity grants to certain senior leaders. 3. Transaction-related charges include contingent consideration, equity-based compensation charges and the amortization of intangible assets and certain other charges associated with acquisitions, and restructuring charges. 4. Merger-related transaction and integration costs includes advisory services, technology integration, equity-based compensation charges and other costs associated with the Company’s merger with Athene. 5. Includes one-time equity-based compensation expense and associated taxes related to the Company’s compensation structure reset. 6. Includes change in fair values of derivatives and embedded derivatives, non-operating change in funding agreements, change in fair value of market risk benefits, and non-operating change in liability for future policy benefits.

**Layout**

Single full-width financial reconciliation slide on a white field. Small all-caps running header 'INVESTOR DAY 2024' sits top-left and the 'APOLLO' wordmark top-right, both at about 4.4% from the top; the serif title sits top-left at about 7% from the top, left-aligned to a 3.2% margin. A borderless table of numbers occupies the middle, with its column headers right-aligned above the numeric columns, and six-line footnotes sit below it at the bottom, followed by the page number 202 at bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Table only; no chart, photograph, diagram or icon. Columns: label column, then 2021, 2022, 2023, LTM 2Q'21, LTM 2Q'24, YTD 2Q'24 under a 'Year ended December 31,' spanner, with '($ in millions)' at top-left of the label column. Rows, in order, are exactly those listed in the table element content, with values right-aligned in each column; bold rows are GAAP Net income attributable to Apollo Global Management Inc. Common Stockholders, GAAP Net income (loss), GAAP Income (loss) before Income tax provision (benefit), Segment Income, Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Net Income Excluding Notable Items; italic section labels are Asset Management Adjustments and Retirement Services Adjustments. Dollar signs appear on the bold total rows; negatives are in parentheses; a dash marks zero. Six bold total rows carry light beige #F4F2F0 bands and thin black rules sit under the column headers.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white corporate financial-report style. Background white #FFFFFF. Title and wordmark in black #000000 Garamond-style serif; header and table text in black #000000 Segoe UI-style humanist sans-serif, regular weight for body rows and bold for totals; footnotes in Segoe UI Light-style sans, black #000000. Title is about 4.8% of slide height (cap height about 3.4%); table and header text about 1.6%; footnote text about 1.4%. Accent is the pale warm grey band #F4F2F0 behind the bold total rows. Lines are hairline black rules under column headers, no corner radii, shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Single white page with a left-aligned title block at top and two stacked financial tables occupying the upper-left and middle-left area. The header label sits top-left and the APOLLO wordmark top-right, both sharing the same top margin. The title spans most of the width at the top, left-aligned at about 3.2% from the left edge. The main income table runs from about 14% to 60% of the height with year columns spaced across the width to about 89%. The share reconciliation table sits below it at about 64% to 77%, left-aligned to the same margin. A footnote sits bottom-left at about 94.6% of the height and the page number sits bottom-right at about 95% of the width.

**Visuals**

Two data tables, no charts, photographs, logos or icons beyond the APOLLO wordmark. Table 1 is an income reconciliation with columns for ($ in millions) and years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021 under a 'Year ended December 31,' heading. **Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate financial-report style on white. Titles in a high-contrast serif (Garamond-style, regular weight) in black, very large relative to the slide. Body and table text in a humanist sans (Segoe UI style) in black, regular weight, with bold for totals and labels. Header and footer use small sans text in black. Subtotal rows are highlighted with a pale warm grey band #F4F2F0. Lines: thin black underlines beneath the year and date column headers. No shapes with rounded corners, shadows or gradients.

Full-bleed teal gradient panel fills the top 79% of the slide, with a plain white band across the bottom 21%. The Apollo Investor Day 2024 lockup sits in the bottom-right white band, right-aligned to about 95% of the width. No footer, page number or slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Full-bleed background image (1536 by 864 px) of a teal-to-slate gradient with faint lighter rectangular blocks whose stepped edges run from about 5% to 89% of the width and from about 17% to 85% of the height. There is no photograph, chart, table or icon. The only other visual is the Apollo Investor Day 2024 wordmark in green at bottom right.

**Design**

Background is a horizontal gradient: slate blue #3E5A7A at the left edge, teal #007B63 at the centre and a muted blue-teal #2E6070 at the right edge, with a white lower band. Title text is white #FFFFFF in Segoe UI Bold, all capitals, sans-serif, set at about 12.2% of slide height. Logo and accent colour is green #007B63. 'APOLLO' and '2024' are set in a small serif, widely letter-spaced capitals for APOLLO. 'INVESTOR DAY' is set in a heavy sans-serif, all capitals. No shadows, borders or corner radii are visible.

INVESTOR DAY 2024 / APOLLO / Additional Important Information / Estimates and Assumptions / This presentation includes certain unaudited financial and business projections and goals on Apollo’s future outlook (the “Estimates”).  Estimates, and their underlying assumptions, are inherently unpredictable and undue reliance should not be placed thereon. / The Estimates reflect the internal financial model that Apollo uses in connection with its strategic planning and are based on numerous variables and assumptions made by Apollo’s management with respect to industry performance, general business, economic, / regulatory, market and financial conditions and other future events, as well as matters specific to Apollo’s businesses, all of which are difficult or impossible to predict accurately and many of which are beyond the control of Apollo’s management. Because the / Estimates cover multiple years, by their nature, they also become subject to greater uncertainty and are less reliable with each successive year. The Estimates reflect subjective judgment in many respects and thus are susceptible to multiple interpretations and / periodic revisions based on actual experience and business developments. As such, the Estimates constitute forward looking information and are subject to many risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results forecasted / in these projections.  Please consider carefully the Forward Looking Statements and Other Important Disclosures at the beginning of this presentation. There can be no assurance that the Estimates will be realized or that actual results will not be significantly / higher or lower than forecast. The Estimates may be affected by Apollo’s ability to achieve strategic goals, objectives and targets over the applicable period. Accordingly, there can be no assurance that the Estimates will be realized, and actual results may vary / materially from those shown. The Estimates cannot, therefore, be considered a guarantee of future operating results, and this information should not be relied on as such. / The inclusion of the Estimates in this presentation should not be regarded as an indication that Apollo or any of its affiliates, advisors, officers, directors or representatives considered or considers the Estimates to be necessarily predictive of actual future events, / and the Estimates should not be relied upon as such. The inclusion of the Estimates herein should not be deemed an admission or representation by Apollo that its management views the Estimates as material information. Neither Apollo nor any of its affiliates, / advisors, officers, directors or representatives has made or makes any representation to any of Apollo’s stockholders or any other person regarding the ultimate performance of Apollo compared to the information contained in the Estimates or can give any / assurance that actual results will not differ materially from the Estimates, and none of them undertakes any obligation to update or otherwise revise or reconcile the Estimates to reflect circumstances existing after the date the Estimates were generated or to / reflect the occurrence of future events even in the event that any or all of the assumptions underlying the Estimates are shown to be in error. / Certain of the projected financial information set forth herein may be considered non-GAAP financial measures. There are limitations inherent in non-GAAP financial measures, because they exclude charges and credits that are required to be included in a GAAP / presentation. Non-GAAP financial measures should not be considered in isolation from, or as a substitute for, financial information presented in compliance with GAAP, and non-GAAP financial measures as used by Apollo may not be comparable to similarly / titled amounts used by other companies.
